title.zh: 卷137 志一百十二 兵八 边防
title.raw: 卷137 志一百十二 兵八 边防

sentences.zh: 志一百十二

translations.literal: Treatise one hundred twelve.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 112.

sentences.zh: 兵八

translations.literal: Military eight.
translations.idiomatic: Military 8.

sentences.zh: 邊防

translations.literal: Frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier Defense.

sentences.zh: 中國邊防，東則三省，北則蒙邊，西則新、甘、川、藏，南則粵、湘、滇、黔，而沿邊台卡，亦內外兼顧，蓋邊防與國防並重焉。

translations.literal: China's frontier defense: to the east are the Three Provinces; to the north the Mongol border; to the west Xinjiang, Gansu, Sichuan, and Tibet; to the south Guangdong, Hunan, Yunnan, and Guizhou; and along the border the watch-stations and passes also attend to both inner and outer—thus frontier defense and national defense are equally important.
translations.idiomatic: China's frontier defenses lay to the east in the Three Eastern Provinces, to the north along the Mongolian borderlands, to the west in Xinjiang, Gansu, Sichuan, and Tibet, and to the south in Guangdong, Hunan, Yunnan, and Guizhou. Border watch-stations and passes were likewise arranged to guard both the interior and the marches, for frontier defense and national defense were held in equal regard.

sentences.zh: 茲分述之：曰東三省，曰甘肅，曰四川，曰雲南，曰廣東，曰廣西，曰蒙古，附直隸、山西，蒙邊防務，曰新疆，曰西藏，曰苗疆，曰沿邊墩台、卡倫、鄂博、碉堡。

translations.literal: Here they are treated separately: the Three Eastern Provinces; Gansu; Sichuan; Yunnan; Guangdong; Guangxi; Mongolia, with Zhili and Shanxi appended on Mongol border defense; Xinjiang; Tibet; the Miao frontier; and along-border beacon towers, karun posts, obos, and blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: They are described in turn below: the Three Eastern Provinces; Gansu; Sichuan; Yunnan; Guangdong; Guangxi; Mongolia, with Zhili and Shanxi included under Mongol border affairs; Xinjiang; Tibet; the Miao frontier; and border beacon towers, karun posts, obos, and blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 東三省為陪都重地，曰奉天，曰吉林，曰黑龍江，東連日、韓，北連俄羅斯，邊防尤要。

translations.literal: The Three Eastern Provinces are the weighty ground of the auxiliary capital: Fengtian, Jilin, and Heilongjiang; to the east they connect with Japan and Korea, to the north with Russia—the frontier defense is especially important.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Eastern Provinces formed the vital region of the secondary capital, comprising Fengtian, Jilin, and Heilongjiang. They bordered Japan and Korea to the east and Russia to the north, and their frontier defenses were of the first importance.

sentences.zh: 奉天當康熙元年，廷臣建議，自興京至山海關，東西千餘里，自開原至金州，南北千餘里，有河東西之分：河東自開原至牛庄，河西自山海關歷松杏山、大凌河，為明季邊防之地，戶口寥落，請預籌實邊。

translations.literal: In Fengtian, in the first year of Kangxi, court ministers proposed that from Xingjing to Shanhaiguan was more than a thousand li east and west, and from Kaiyuan to Jinzhou more than a thousand li north and south, with a division east and west of the river: east of the river from Kaiyuan to Niuzhuang, west of the river from Shanhaiguan through Songxing Mountain and the Daling River—the Ming-period frontier defense land, with sparse population, and they requested advance planning to solidify the border.
translations.idiomatic: In Fengtian, as early as the first year of the Kangxi reign, court ministers urged that from Xingjing to Shanhaiguan stretched more than a thousand li east to west, and from Kaiyuan to Jinzhou more than a thousand li north to south. The region was divided by the river: east of the river from Kaiyuan to Niuzhuang, and west of the river from Shanhaiguan through Songxing Mountain and the Daling River—lands that had served as Ming frontier defenses but were now thinly settled. They called for advance measures to strengthen the border in earnest.

sentences.zh: 嗣後休養生聚，城鎮日繁。

translations.literal: Afterward, through rest and increase of population, towns and markets grew daily.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, as the people recovered and multiplied, towns and markets grew steadily denser.

sentences.zh: 凡大城十四，邊門二十餘。

translations.literal: In all there were fourteen major cities and more than twenty border gates.
translations.idiomatic: In all there were fourteen major cities and more than twenty border gates.

sentences.zh: 至同治間，邊界漸廣。

translations.literal: By the Tongzhi period the border gradually widened.
translations.idiomatic: By the Tongzhi era the frontier had gradually expanded.

sentences.zh: 將軍都興阿以鳳、靉二邊門外之地，自靉陽門外八里甸子東至兩江匯口，轉西南至海沿而下，直至貢道北老邊牆，南路經孤頂子等岡，由西南至舊邊小黑山，均展拓為邊界。

translations.literal: The general Duxing'a took the land outside the Feng and Ai border gates, from outside Aiyang Gate at Balidianzi east to the confluence of the two rivers, turning southwest down along the seacoast to the old border wall north of the tribute road, and the southern route passing Gudingzi and other hills, from the southwest to the old border at Xiaoheishan—all were extended as the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: General Duxing'a extended the boundary to include the territory beyond the Feng and Ai border gates—from Balidianzi east of Aiyang Gate to the confluence of the two rivers, then southwest along the coast to the old border wall north of the tribute route, and southward over hills such as Gudingzi to the old frontier at Xiaoheishan.

sentences.zh: 此外若大東溝江海相連之處，一律查勘，以綏籓服。

translations.literal: Besides this, places such as Dadonggou where river and sea connect were all surveyed, to pacify the subject peoples.
translations.idiomatic: Elsewhere, at points such as Dadonggou where river and sea met, surveys were carried out everywhere to secure the allegiance of frontier peoples.

sentences.zh: 尋以地方遼闊，增調防軍。

translations.literal: Soon, because the territory was vast, additional frontier garrison troops were transferred.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, because the region was so vast, additional frontier garrisons were posted.

sentences.zh: 其防軍之外，尤以練軍為重。

translations.literal: Beyond the frontier garrison troops, drilled armies were especially emphasized.
translations.idiomatic: Apart from the regular frontier garrisons, drilled troops were regarded as especially important.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，崇實以金州、大東溝等處，旗兵不足，增練步隊分防。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu, Chongshi, because at Jinzhou, Dadonggou, and other places Banner troops were insufficient, increased drilled infantry companies for divided defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Guangxu, Chongshi found the Banner forces inadequate at Jinzhou, Dadonggou, and other points, and added drilled infantry companies for local defense.

sentences.zh: 十一年，王大臣等會議，奉天界接朝鮮，舊以遼陽迤東鳳凰城等四城為要地。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, princes and ministers met in council: Fengtian's border adjoins Korea; formerly the four cities from Liaoyang eastward including Fenghuangcheng were regarded as key places.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Guangxu, princes and ministers met in council. Fengtian bordered Korea, and the four cities from Liaoyang eastward, including Fenghuangcheng, had long been treated as vital points.

sentences.zh: 今則水路趨重大連灣、旅順口，陸路自同治間開墾荒地以後，耕廛比櫛，直抵鴨綠江西岸。

translations.literal: Now by water the emphasis shifts to Dalian Bay and Lüshunkou; by land, since the opening of wasteland in the Tongzhi period, farms and hamlets stand close together, reaching straight to the west bank of the Yalu River.
translations.idiomatic: By sea the focus had shifted to Dalian Bay and Port Arthur; by land, since wasteland was opened in the Tongzhi era, farms and hamlets stood shoulder to shoulder all the way to the west bank of the Yalu.

sentences.zh: 額設防兵二萬二千餘人，新設練軍及緝捕勇丁一萬三千餘人，而練習新式槍砲者不及半數，宜加練大支勁旅，扼要屯駐。

translations.literal: Established frontier troops numbered more than twenty-two thousand; newly established drilled armies and pursuit brave levies more than thirteen thousand; yet those trained in new-style firearms and cannon were fewer than half—they should add drilling of a large strong force and garrison it at strategic points.
translations.idiomatic: Established frontier troops numbered more than twenty-two thousand, with newly formed drilled armies and pursuit levies adding another thirteen thousand, yet fewer than half were trained in modern firearms and artillery. A large, well-drilled force should be raised and posted at the decisive points.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，以延吉廳一帶為交涉要地，令奉省疆吏調遣軍隊，分配憲兵，建築營房。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong, because the Yanji subprefecture area was a key place for negotiations, Fengtian frontier officials were ordered to deploy troops, assign gendarmes, and build barracks.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuantong, because the Yanji subprefecture district was a critical zone for diplomatic dealings, Fengtian authorities were ordered to deploy troops, assign gendarmes, and erect barracks.

sentences.zh: 新設之長白廳，開山通道，駐兵建署。

translations.literal: At the newly established Changbai subprefecture, mountains were opened and roads cut through, troops stationed and offices built.
translations.idiomatic: At the newly established Changbai subprefecture, roads were cut through the mountains, troops were stationed, and government offices were built.

sentences.zh: 鴨綠江上游之防務，亦次第籌備。

translations.literal: Defenses along the upper Yalu River were also prepared in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Defenses along the upper Yalu were likewise prepared step by step.

sentences.zh: 蓋自日據朝鮮，與奉、吉接壤，東邊防務，日益亟矣。

translations.literal: For since Japan occupied Korea and bordered Fengtian and Jilin, eastern frontier defense grew daily more urgent.
translations.idiomatic: Once Japan had taken Korea and stood adjacent to Fengtian and Jilin, the defense of the eastern marches grew more pressing with every year.

sentences.zh: 吉林凡大城八，邊門四。

translations.literal: Jilin had eight major cities and four border gates.
translations.idiomatic: Jilin had eight major cities and four border gates.

sentences.zh: 其防務至重者，一為琿春，與俄羅斯偪壤，兼接朝鮮，曠無障阻。

translations.literal: Its weightiest defenses were, first, Hunchun, pressed against Russian territory and also adjoining Korea, open without barrier.
translations.idiomatic: Its most critical defenses were, first, Hunchun, pressed against Russian territory and adjoining Korea as well, with open country and no natural barrier.

sentences.zh: 一為三姓，乃松花江之上游，伯都訥腹地之屏蔽。

translations.literal: Second, Sanxing, the upper reaches of the Songhua River, the screen of the heartland of Boduna.
translations.idiomatic: Second was Sanxing, on the upper Songhua, shielding the heartland of Boduna.

sentences.zh: 其三岔口，可由蒙古草地達奉天法庫邊門。

translations.literal: Third, Sanchakou, from which one could reach Fengtian's Faku border gate through the Mongolian grasslands.
translations.idiomatic: Third was Sanchakou, from which one could reach Fengtian's Faku border gate across the Mongolian steppe.

sentences.zh: 光緒初年，就未練之兵及八旗台站西丹內，選精壯者，練馬步四營。

translations.literal: In the early Guangxu years, from untrained troops and among Banner relay-station xidan, the strong were chosen and four horse and foot battalions were drilled.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Guangxu years, picked men from untrained troops and from Banner relay-station xidan were formed into four drilled horse and foot battalions.

sentences.zh: 七年，吳大澂始於吉林創設機器局，製造軍械，並於扼要處建築砲台。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Wu Dacheng first established an arsenal in Jilin to manufacture arms, and built batteries at strategic points.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Wu Dacheng established an arsenal in Jilin to manufacture arms and built batteries at strategic points.

sentences.zh: 以陸路轉運維艱，協商直隸督臣李鴻章，派員及熟手工匠至吉林開廠。

translations.literal: Because overland transport was difficult, he consulted with Zhili Governor-General Li Hongzhang and sent officials and skilled artisans to open the factory in Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Because overland transport was difficult, he arranged with Zhili Governor-General Li Hongzhang to send officials and skilled artisans to open the factory in Jilin.

sentences.zh: 俟廠局告成，再於寧古塔、琿春等處增築砲台。

translations.literal: When the factory was completed, batteries would be further built at Ningguta, Hunchun, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Once the factory was finished, additional batteries were to be built at Ningguta, Hunchun, and other points.

sentences.zh: 十一年，增練馬隊步隊共六營，足四千五百人之數，隸左右翼統率訓練。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, six additional drilled horse and foot battalions were added, totaling four thousand five hundred men, placed under left and right wing command for training.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, six more drilled horse and foot battalions were added, four thousand five hundred men in all, placed under left- and right-wing command for training.

sentences.zh: 吉林額設防兵及烏拉牲丁，凡一萬五千餘人，內靖萑苻，外支強敵，時虞不給雲。

translations.literal: Jilin's established frontier troops and ura draft laborers totaled more than fifteen thousand; to pacify bandits within and resist strong enemies without, they were often feared insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Jilin's established frontier troops and ura labor levies totaled more than fifteen thousand—barely enough, it was feared, to keep order within and hold off powerful enemies without.

sentences.zh: 黑龍江凡大城六，新舊卡倫七十一。

translations.literal: Heilongjiang had six major cities and seventy-one old and new karun posts.
translations.idiomatic: Heilongjiang had six major cities and seventy-one karun posts, old and new.

sentences.zh: 中、俄接界，向以尼布楚與恰克圖為重地，故斥堠之設，多在北徼。

translations.literal: Where China and Russia meet, Nerchinsk and Kyakhta had long been weighty places, so outpost stations were mostly set along the northern marches.
translations.idiomatic: Along the Sino-Russian border, Nerchinsk and Kyakhta had long been the chief points, and most outposts were therefore placed on the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 舊制於歲之五、六月間，齊齊哈爾、墨爾根、黑龍江三處疆吏，各遣協領、佐領等官，率兵分三路，至格爾畢齊、額爾古訥、墨里勒克、楚爾海圖等處巡視，歲終具疏以聞。

translations.literal: Under the old system, in the fifth and sixth months of the year the frontier officials of Qiqihar, Mergen, and Heilongjiang each sent assistant commandants, company commandants, and other officers leading troops in three routes to Ge'erbiqi, Ergun, Merileke, Churhaitu, and other places for inspection, and at year's end submitted memorials reporting.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old regulations, in the fifth and sixth months the frontier officials of Qiqihar, Mergen, and Heilongjiang each dispatched assistant commandants and company commandants with troops along three routes to Ge'erbiqi, the Ergun, Merileke, Churhaitu, and other points on inspection, reporting by memorial at year's end.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十三年，始設將軍以下各官以鎮守之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Kangxi, a general and subordinate officials were first established to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of Kangxi, a general and subordinate officials were first appointed to garrison the region.

sentences.zh: 凡前鋒、領催、馬甲、匠役、養育兵，咸歸統率，額設之兵，一萬三千餘人。

translations.literal: All vanguard, squad leaders, horse armor, artisans, and breeding soldiers were placed under unified command; established troops numbered more than thirteen thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Vanguard, squad leaders, horse armor, artisans, and breeding soldiers were all placed under unified command, with more than thirteen thousand men on the rolls.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，以正兵六千人，西丹四千人，合練步隊萬人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu, six thousand regular troops and four thousand xidan were combined to drill ten thousand infantry.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangxu, six thousand regular troops and four thousand xidan were combined into ten thousand drilled infantry.

sentences.zh: 時俄騎東略，沿邊自北而東，列戍防秋，遂無寧歲。

translations.literal: At that time Russian cavalry pressed east; along the border from north to east garrisons stood against autumn raids, and there was no peaceful year.
translations.idiomatic: Russian cavalry were then pressing eastward, and garrisons lined the frontier from north to east against autumn raids, so that scarcely a year passed in peace.

sentences.zh: 六年，加練西丹五千人，分佈愛琿、呼倫貝爾、布特哈、墨爾根、呼蘭、齊齊哈爾等處。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, five thousand additional drilled xidan were distributed at Aihui, Hulunbuir, Buteha, Mergen, Hulan, Qiqihar, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, five thousand more drilled xidan were posted at Aihui, Hulunbuir, Buteha, Mergen, Hulan, Qiqihar, and other stations.

sentences.zh: 原有馬隊二千人，加練千人，秋冬之際，招集打牲人等，加以訓練，以佐兵力。

translations.literal: The original two thousand horse troops had one thousand more drilled; in autumn and winter hunters and others were gathered and trained to assist military strength.
translations.idiomatic: The existing two-thousand-man cavalry had another thousand drilled, and in autumn and winter hunters and others were mustered and trained to supplement the regular forces.

sentences.zh: 八年，籌備黑龍江邊防，在奉天調教習，在天津運砲械，共練馬隊五千人，分駐各城。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Heilongjiang frontier defense was prepared: instructors were trained in Fengtian, cannon and arms shipped from Tianjin, and five thousand cavalry drilled and distributed to garrison the various cities.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Heilongjiang's frontier defenses were reorganized: instructors were trained in Fengtian, artillery shipped from Tianjin, and five thousand cavalry drilled and posted to the various cities.

sentences.zh: 裁舊設卡倫二十六處，以新練之隊伍巡防。

translations.literal: Twenty-six old karun posts were abolished and the newly drilled units took over patrol defense.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-six old karun posts were abolished, and the newly drilled units took over patrol duty.

sentences.zh: 十一年，命奉天、吉林、黑龍江三省疆吏各練勁兵，為東西策應之師，並墾闢荒地，開採礦山，為實邊之計。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the frontier officials of Fengtian, Jilin, and Heilongjiang were each ordered to drill strong troops as eastern and western supporting armies, and to open wasteland and mines as plans to solidify the border.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, the governors of Fengtian, Jilin, and Heilongjiang were each ordered to drill crack troops as eastern and western reserves, and to open wasteland and mines as measures to strengthen the frontier in substance.

sentences.zh: 黑龍江復增練馬步各營。

translations.literal: Heilongjiang further added drilled horse and foot battalions.
translations.idiomatic: Heilongjiang added further drilled horse and foot battalions.

sentences.zh: 蓋自俄人侵食黑龍江以北，及烏蘇里江、興凱湖以東各地，處處與我連界，邊防日重。

translations.literal: For since Russians encroached north of the Heilongjiang and on lands east of the Ussuri and Lake Khanka, everywhere bordering us, frontier defense grew daily heavier.
translations.idiomatic: As Russia encroached north of the Heilongjiang and on lands east of the Ussuri and Lake Khanka, bordering Chinese territory at every turn, the frontier burden grew heavier by the day.

sentences.zh: 及俄築東清鐵道，日佔南滿，於是防不勝防雲。

translations.literal: When Russia built the Chinese Eastern Railway and Japan occupied southern Manchuria, defense could no longer keep pace.
translations.idiomatic: Once Russia built the Chinese Eastern Railway and Japan occupied southern Manchuria, the frontier could scarcely be defended at all.

sentences.zh: 甘肅北達蒙部，南雜番、回，西接新疆、寧夏，以河套為屏籓，西寧與撒喇相錯處，為西陲奧區。

translations.literal: Gansu reached the Mongol departments in the north, mixed with tribes and Muslims in the south, adjoined Xinjiang and Ningxia in the west; the Hetao was its screen, and where Xining and Salar intermingled was the vital region of the western marches.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu reached the Mongol lands in the north, bordered tribal and Muslim peoples in the south, and adjoined Xinjiang and Ningxia in the west. The Hetao formed its shield, and the zone where Xining and the Salar intermingled was the strategic heart of the western frontier.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十三年，增戍兵五百於大馬營，控扼雪山要路，增馬步兵三千人於定羌廟，以守硤口，咸隸於肅州總兵官。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year of Kangxi, five hundred additional garrison troops were posted at Damaying to control the vital Snow Mountain route; three thousand horse and foot were added at Dingqiang Temple to guard the pass—all under the Jiuquan regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year of Kangxi, five hundred more garrison troops were posted at Damaying to hold the vital Snow Mountain route, and three thousand horse and foot at Dingqiang Temple to guard the pass—all under the Jiuquan regional commander.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，青海蕩平，於西寧之北，川邊之外，自巴爾託海至扁都口一帶，創築邊牆城堡，於青海、巴爾虎、鹽池等處，設副將以下各官，於大通河南北，設參將以下各官。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng, Qinghai was pacified; north of Xining and beyond the Sichuan border, from Ba'ertuohai to Biandukou, border walls and forts were newly built; at Qinghai, Barhu, Yanchi, and other places deputy commanders and subordinate officers were established; north and south of the Datong River, brigade commanders and subordinate officers were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongzheng, after Qinghai was pacified, border walls and forts were built from Ba'ertuohai to Biandukou north of Xining and beyond the Sichuan frontier. Deputy commanders and subordinates were posted at Qinghai, Barhu, Yanchi, and other stations, and brigade commanders and subordinates north and south of the Datong River.

sentences.zh: 以西陲重要，全省馬步戰守兵凡五萬七千餘人，關外換防兵凡九千餘人，兵額獨多於他省。

translations.literal: Because the western marches were important, the province's horse and foot battle and garrison troops totaled more than fifty-seven thousand, and frontier rotation troops more than nine thousand—the military quota alone exceeded other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Because the western frontier was vital, the province mustered more than fifty-seven thousand horse and foot for battle and garrison duty, with another nine thousand rotation troops beyond the passes—more men on the rolls than any other province.

sentences.zh: 三年，以布隆吉爾為安西鎮，設總兵等官，額兵五千人。

translations.literal: In the third year, Bulongji'er was made Anxi garrison, with regional commander and other officers established, quota troops five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Bulongji'er was made the Anxi garrison, with a regional commander and subordinates appointed and a quota of five thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 因庄浪西之仙米寺地方，山深林密，設守備等官，移涼州高古城額兵駐守。

translations.literal: Because the Xianmi Temple area west of Zhuanglang had deep mountains and dense forest, a garrison commandant and other officers were established, and troops from Liangzhou's Gaogucheng quota were moved to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Xianmi Temple district west of Zhuanglang lay in deep mountains and thick forest, a garrison commandant was appointed and troops from Liangzhou's Gaogucheng quota were transferred to hold it.

sentences.zh: 五年，於大通鎮設馬步兵二千人，以白塔川、側爾吐二處逼近邊境，各設兵八百人。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, two thousand horse and foot were established at Datong garrison; because Baitachuan and Ce'ertu were close to the border, eight hundred troops were posted at each.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, two thousand horse and foot were posted at Datong, and eight hundred men each at Baitachuan and Ce'ertu, both near the frontier.

sentences.zh: 以插漢地方遼闊，設寶豐、新渠二縣，設文武各官，並增戍兵，控制賀蘭山一帶。

translations.literal: Because the Chahan region was vast, Baofeng and Xinqu counties were established, civil and military officers appointed, and garrison troops increased to control the Helan Mountain area.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Chahan region was vast, Baofeng and Xinqu counties were created with civil and military officials, and additional garrison troops were posted to control the Helan Mountains.

sentences.zh: 八年，岳鍾琪於吐魯番通伊犁之要路，嚴設卡倫，巴爾庫庫等處，多駐防兵，闊舍圖地方，為南北二山鎖合處，屯駐重兵，分防南北山口。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Yue Zhongqi strictly established karun posts on the vital road from Turfan to Ili; at Barkul and other places many frontier troops were stationed; at Kuoshetu, where north and south mountains lock together, heavy troops were encamped to defend the north and south passes separately.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Yue Zhongqi tightened karun posts along the vital route from Turfan to Ili, posted more frontier troops at Barkul and elsewhere, and massed a strong force at Kuoshetu, where the northern and southern ranges meet, to guard the passes on both sides.

sentences.zh: 十一年，因西路之布隆吉爾，北連哈密，西接沙州，為關外重地，乃建築城垣，屯兵防守。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, because Bulongji'er on the western route connected north with Hami and west with Shazhou, a weighty place beyond the passes, city walls were built and troops encamped for defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, because Bulongji'er on the western route linked Hami to the north and Shazhou to the west and was a critical post beyond the passes, walls were built and troops encamped for its defense.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十九年，福康安、阿桂籌備邊防，自蘭州迤東至涇州一千餘里，北達邊城，外則番族環居，內則回民錯處，墩戍寥落，乃擇要增設營戍，凡將弁二十三人，兵丁二千人。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year of Qianlong, Fukang'an and Agui prepared frontier defense; from Lanzhou east to Jingzhou for more than a thousand li, reaching border cities in the north, with tribes surrounding outside and Muslims intermingling within, beacon towers and garrisons were sparse—key points were chosen to add camps and garrisons: twenty-three officers and two thousand soldiers in all.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year of Qianlong, Fukang'an and Agui reorganized the frontier defenses. From Lanzhou east to Jingzhou for more than a thousand li, reaching the border towns in the north, tribes ringed the outer marches and Muslim communities lay scattered within, while beacon towers and garrisons were thin on the ground. They therefore added camps at key points—twenty-three officers and two thousand men in all.

sentences.zh: 嗣又增兵三千人，北路靖遠，南路秦、階，大河東西各處，互為捍衛。

translations.literal: Later three thousand more troops were added; on the northern route Jingyuan, on the southern Qin and Jie, and on both banks of the great river, each place mutually defended the others.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand more troops were later added, with Jingyuan on the northern route, Qin and Jie on the southern, and posts on both banks of the great river supporting one another.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，以察罕諾門汗投誠，其所轄二十族，分為左右二翼，視蒙古例，每翼統以專員，嚴稽關卡，以孤河北野番之勢。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang, because the Qaghan Nomon Khan submitted, his twenty tribes were divided into left and right wings following the Mongol precedent, each wing governed by a dedicated official, passes strictly inspected, to isolate the power of the wild tribes north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daoguang, when the Qaghan Nomon Khan submitted, his twenty tribes were divided into left and right wings on the Mongol model, each under a dedicated official with strict control of passes, to isolate the wild tribes north of the river.

sentences.zh: 三年，因青海蒙古向未有受事盟長，乃就青海二十旗內，設正副盟長各一人，隨同官兵習武，以防番眾渡河。

translations.literal: In the third year, because Qinghai Mongols had never had league chiefs who received imperial investiture, within the twenty banners of Qinghai one chief and one deputy chief of the league were established each, drilling with government troops to guard against tribes crossing the river.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, because the Qinghai Mongols had never had league chiefs bearing imperial commission, one chief and one deputy were appointed among the twenty banners to drill with government troops and guard against tribes crossing the river.

sentences.zh: 十一年，楊遇春於察罕託洛地方，增設蒙古兵，分作二班，布守各卡，以佐官兵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Yang Yuchun at Chahan Tuoluo added Mongol troops in two shifts to garrison the various karun posts and assist government troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Yang Yuchun added Mongol troops at Chahan Tuoluo in two shifts to man the karun posts and support the regular forces.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，富尼揚阿於將軍台、會亭子二處，各建城垣，防禦西番。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Funiyang'a at Jiangjun Terrace and Huitingzi built city walls at each place to defend against western tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, Funiyang'a built walls at Jiangjun Terrace and Huitingzi to defend against western tribes.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，布彥泰以番賊擾邊，規復防河舊制，增兵千人，分佈沿河渡口。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Buyantai, because tribal bandits harassed the border, planned to restore the old river-defense system, added one thousand troops distributed along river crossings.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, Buyantai, with tribal raiders harassing the frontier, planned to restore the old river-defense system and added one thousand men posted along the crossings.

sentences.zh: 又哈喇庫圖爾營所屬之南山根，及南川營所屬之青石坡二處，為野番出入總路，各以汛兵駐守。

translations.literal: Also at the southern foot of the mountains under Halakutu'er camp and at Qingshipo under Nachuan camp—two places that were the main routes for wild tribes to enter and leave—flood-season troops were stationed at each.
translations.idiomatic: At the southern foothills under Halakutu'er camp and at Qingshipo under Nachuan camp—the main routes by which wild tribes entered and left—seasonal garrison troops were posted.

sentences.zh: 永安營、紅崖營、永昌協所屬之扁都口、石灰關各要口三十八處，均撥兵巡守，自數十人至百餘人不等。

translations.literal: At Yong'an camp, Hongya camp, and the thirty-eight vital passes such as Biandukou and Shihuiguan under Yongchang brigade, troops were assigned for patrol, from several tens to more than a hundred men each.
translations.idiomatic: At Yong'an, Hongya, and the thirty-eight vital passes such as Biandukou and Shihuiguan under the Yongchang brigade, patrol troops were assigned in numbers ranging from several dozen to more than a hundred.

sentences.zh: 沿邊小口，各備坑塹，以遏賊騎。

translations.literal: Along small border passes, pits and trenches were prepared at each to check enemy cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: At each minor border pass, pits and trenches were prepared to check raiding horsemen.

sentences.zh: 時番賊恃其槍馬便利，頻年竄擾，亦斯門沁地方，為番騎來往要區，募獵戶千人編為一軍，供遠探近防之用。

translations.literal: At that time tribal bandits relied on the convenience of firearms and horses and raided year after year; Yisimengqin was also a vital zone for tribal cavalry to come and go—a thousand hunters were recruited and formed into one army for distant reconnaissance and nearby defense.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal raiders then relied on firearms and swift horses and struck year after year. Yisimengqin was a key corridor for tribal horsemen, and a thousand hunters were recruited into a corps for long-range scouting and local defense.

sentences.zh: 旋以亦斯門沁設兵，僅可防甘、涼二州之扁都口等隘二十七處，兵力尚嫌不足，復於沙金城設兵千人，以防涼州所屬之一顆樹等三十處隘口，於野牛溝設兵千人，以防甘州所屬之大磁窯等十八處隘口。

translations.literal: Soon troops at Yisimengqin could only defend twenty-seven passes such as Biandukou in Gan and Liang—the force was still deemed insufficient; another thousand were posted at Shajincheng for thirty passes such as Yikeshu under Liangzhou, and a thousand at Yeniugou for eighteen passes such as Daciyao under Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Troops at Yisimengqin could soon guard only twenty-seven passes such as Biandukou in Gan and Liang, and the force was still judged inadequate. Another thousand men were posted at Shajincheng for thirty Liangzhou passes such as Yikeshu, and a thousand at Yeniugou for eighteen Ganzhou passes such as Daciyao.

sentences.zh: 提鎮大員，復督率沿邊將弁，先事預防。

translations.literal: Provincial commanders and garrison generals further supervised frontier officers to take preventive measures in advance.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial commanders and garrison generals in turn supervised frontier officers to take preventive measures in advance.

sentences.zh: 自粵寇披猖，回匪乘之，玉關、雪嶺間，騷然不靖。

translations.literal: Since the Cantonese rebels ran rampant and Muslim bandits took advantage, between Jade Gate and Snow Ridge all was disturbed and unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Cantonese rebels swept the land and Muslim insurgents seized their chance, the region between Jade Gate and Snow Ridge was thrown into turmoil.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，以番賊復出，令琦善等撥兵設卡，嚴密巡防。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng, because tribal bandits reappeared, Qishan and others were ordered to allocate troops and establish karun posts for strict patrol defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng, with tribal raiders active again, Qishan and others were ordered to allocate troops, establish karun posts, and tighten patrols.

sentences.zh: 二年，令舒興阿等督率邊卡文武，修濠壘，增馬探，各營定期會哨，分途堵截。

translations.literal: In the second year, Shuxing'a and others were ordered to supervise civil and military officials at border posts to repair moats and ramparts, increase mounted scouts, hold regular joint patrols among camps, and block routes separately.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Shuxing'a and others were ordered to supervise border officials in repairing moats and ramparts, increasing mounted scouts, holding regular joint patrols, and blocking enemy routes in separate columns.

sentences.zh: 四年，因西寧一帶，番族窺伺，增募獵戶三千人，分防隘口。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, because around Xining tribes watched for opportunity, three thousand hunters were additionally recruited and distributed to defend passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, with tribes watching for openings around Xining, three thousand more hunters were recruited and posted at the passes.

sentences.zh: 八年，以青海迤西戈壁，給番民暫居，令西寧總兵、道員，定立界址。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the Gobi west of Qinghai was given for tribes to dwell temporarily; the Xining regional commander and circuit intendant were ordered to fix boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, tribes were allowed temporary residence in the Gobi west of Qinghai, and the Xining regional commander and circuit intendant were ordered to fix the boundaries.

sentences.zh: 九年，令甘肅省疆臣督辦團練事宜。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Gansu frontier officials were ordered to supervise local militia affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, Gansu's frontier officials were ordered to oversee local militia organization.

sentences.zh: 同治十年，豫師等於甘、涼各處邊隘，自平番至威遠各口，及巴燕戎格山後與西寧番地通連者，一律加意嚴防。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Tongzhi, Yushi and others at border passes in Gan and Liang, from Pingfan to Weiyuan and places connecting behind Bayan Rongge Mountain with Xining tribal lands, all received strict added defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Tongzhi, Yushi and others tightened defenses at border passes throughout Gan and Liang—from Pingfan to Weiyuan and along routes connecting Bayan Rongge with Xining tribal territory.

sentences.zh: 張曜因甘肅之金塔一帶，邊牆損壞，平番之裴家營，古浪之大靖、土門，甘、涼之南山各口，時有土番竄擾，分遣員弁偵探防堵。

translations.literal: Zhang Yao, because in Gansu's Jinta area the border wall was damaged, and at Pingfan's Peijiaying, Gulang's Dajing and Tumen, and the southern mountain passes of Gan and Liang, local tribes often raided, dispatched officers for reconnaissance and blocking defense.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yao found the border wall damaged around Jinta and local tribes raiding Peijiaying in Pingfan, Dajing and Tumen in Gulang, and the southern passes of Gan and Liang; he dispatched officers to scout and block them.

sentences.zh: 十一年，左宗棠於河州迤西之西南北三面，毗連番界，及槐樹關、老鴉關、土門關三隘口，與抱罕羌人接境之處，以歸化之番眾僧俗四千人，馬四千餘匹，防守各關。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Zuo Zongtang on the southwest, south, and north of Hezhou westward, bordering tribal territory, and at the three passes Huashuguan, Laoyaguan, and Tumenguan where they adjoined the Baochan Qiang, used four thousand submitted tribal monks and laymen and more than four thousand horses to defend the various passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Zuo Zongtang posted four thousand submitted tribal monks and laymen with more than four thousand horses to hold the passes on the southwest, south, and north west of Hezhou, including Huashuguan, Laoyaguan, and Tumenguan on the Baochan Qiang frontier.

sentences.zh: 是時，平定關、隴，皆客軍之力，數萬額兵，幾同虛設。

translations.literal: At that time pacifying Guan and Long depended entirely on guest armies; tens of thousands of quota troops were nearly a dead letter.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification of Guan and Long then depended entirely on guest armies, while tens of thousands of men on the provincial rolls were nearly useless.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠懲前毖後，乃減兵加餉，繕器械，簡軍實，以重邊防。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang, learning from past mistakes to guard the future, then reduced troops and increased pay, repaired weapons, trimmed military substance, to strengthen frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: Learning from past failures, Zuo Zongtang cut rolls, raised pay, repaired arms, and tightened discipline to strengthen the frontier.

sentences.zh: 惟新設之靈武、化平、硝海三營兵數無多，逼近蒙、番之永昌、庄浪、松山三營，仍循舊額雲。

translations.literal: Only the newly established Lingwu, Huaping, and Xiaohai camps had few troops; Yongchang, Zhuanglang, and Songshan camps close to Mongols and tribes still followed the old quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Only the newly formed camps at Lingwu, Huaping, and Xiaohai had small complements, while Yongchang, Zhuanglang, and Songshan on the Mongol and tribal frontiers still kept their old quotas.

sentences.zh: 四川西連衛、藏，北接青海，南盡蠻夷。

translations.literal: Sichuan in the west connected with Wei and Tibet, in the north adjoined Qinghai, in the south reached to the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan bordered Wei and Tibet in the west, Qinghai in the north, and tribal lands to the south.

sentences.zh: 自雍正、乾隆間，青海、大小金川次第綏定，沿邊之防，以打箭爐為尤重。

translations.literal: From the Yongzheng and Qianlong periods, Qinghai and the Greater and Lesser Jin River regions were pacified in turn; along the border defense, Dajianlu was especially weighty.
translations.idiomatic: From the Yongzheng and Qianlong reigns onward, Qinghai and the Greater and Lesser Jin River regions were pacified in turn, and frontier defense centered above all on Dajianlu.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十九年，移化林營於打箭爐，以防爐番。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year of Kangxi, Hualin camp was moved to Dajianlu to guard against Dajianlu tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year of Kangxi, Hualin camp was moved to Dajianlu to guard against the local tribes.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，年羹堯於川、陝各處邊隘，擇要增兵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, Nian Gengyao at border passes in Sichuan and Shaanxi chose key points to increase troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongzheng, Nian Gengyao reinforced troops at key border passes throughout Sichuan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 一為中渡河口，乃通西藏要路，修築土城，以守備移駐。

translations.literal: First, Zhongduhekou, the vital road to Tibet—a earthen city was built and a garrison commandant moved to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: First was Zhongduhekou, the vital route to Tibet, where an earthen fort was built and a garrison commandant posted.

sentences.zh: 一為保縣，在大河之南，乃土番出沒之所，一為越巂，地多蠻裸，一為松潘外之阿樹，及黃勝岡、察木多，均撥兵駐守，設游擊、千總等官。

translations.literal: Second, Baoxian, south of the great river, where native tribes came and went; third, Yuexi, where many naked barbarians lived; fourth, Ashu beyond Songpan, and Huangshenggang and Chamdo—all had troops assigned to garrison and mobile corps and company commanders established.
translations.idiomatic: Second was Baoxian south of the great river, where native tribes came and went; third was Yuexi, home to many tribal peoples; fourth were Ashu beyond Songpan, Huangshenggang, and Chamdo—troops were posted at each with mobile corps and company commanders appointed.

sentences.zh: 二年，青海蕩平，於邊外單葛耳斯地方，設參將等官。

translations.literal: In the second year, Qinghai was pacified; beyond the border at Dangge'ersi, brigade commanders and other officers were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, after Qinghai was pacified, brigade commanders and subordinates were posted beyond the border at Dangge'ersi.

sentences.zh: 暗門、拉科、恆鈴子三處，設守備等官。

translations.literal: At Anmen, Lake, and Henglingzi three places, garrison commandants and other officers were established.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison commandants were appointed at Anmen, Lake, and Henglingzi.

sentences.zh: 河州保安堡，設游擊等官。

translations.literal: At Hezhou Bao'an Fort, mobile corps and other officers were established.
translations.idiomatic: A mobile corps and subordinates were posted at Hezhou Bao'an Fort.

sentences.zh: 打箭爐外之木雅吉達、鴉龍江中渡、里塘、巴塘、鄂洛五處，設總兵、副將等官，率兵駐守。

translations.literal: Beyond Dajianlu at Muyajida, Yalong River Zhongdu, Litang, Batang, and Eluo five places, regional commanders, deputy commanders, and other officers were established leading troops to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond Dajianlu, regional and deputy commanders with troops were posted at Muyajida, Yalong River Zhongdu, Litang, Batang, and Eluo.

sentences.zh: 六年，岳鍾琪因河東西苗民改土歸流以後，建昌遂為沿邊重鎮，乃於柏香坪、冕山、寧番、寧越、鹽井、波沙、托木、熱水等處，增設將備營汛，合原有之弁兵，咸隸於建昌鎮標。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Yue Zhongqi, because after the Miao on both banks of the river were brought under direct rule Jianchang became a weighty frontier town, at Boxiangping, Mianshan, Ningfan, Ningyue, Yanjing, Bosha, Tuomu, Reshui, and other places added officers, camps, and flood garrisons; together with existing officers and troops, all were placed under the Jianchang garrison standard.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, after the Miao on both banks of the river were brought under direct administration and Jianchang became a major frontier town, Yue Zhongqi added officers, camps, and garrisons at Boxiangping, Mianshan, Ningfan, Ningyue, Yanjing, Bosha, Tuomu, Reshui, and other points, placing all troops, old and new, under the Jianchang garrison.

sentences.zh: 十年，黃廷桂以建昌之竹核，及涼山西南之魚紅地方，當諸蠻出入門戶，谷堆、格落二處，大赤口、小河壩、勒必鐵、阿都四處，皆系邊要，乃於竹核設將備兵丁共三千人，阿都設兵千人。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Huang Tinggui, because Jianchang's Zhuhe and Liangshan's southwest Yuhong were gateways for various barbarians to enter and leave, and Gudui, Geluo, Dachikou, Xiaoheba, Leibitie, and Adu were all border vital points, at Zhuhe established officers and three thousand soldiers, at Adu one thousand soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Huang Tinggui held Zhuhe in Jianchang and Yuhong in southwestern Liangshan as gateways for tribal raiders, with Gudui, Geluo, Dachikou, Xiaoheba, Leibitie, and Adu all vital points. He posted three thousand men at Zhuhe and a thousand at Adu.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十七年，岳鍾琪因番眾投誠，以威茂副將移駐雜谷腦，設兵千二百人，西南境與梭卓接壤之處，均設汛駐兵。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Qianlong, Yue Zhongqi, because tribes submitted, moved the Weimao deputy commander to Zagu'nao, established twelve hundred troops, and at places on the southwest border adjoining Suozhuo set flood garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Qianlong, with tribes submitting, Yue Zhongqi moved the Weimao deputy commander to Zagu'nao with twelve hundred men and posted seasonal garrisons along the southwestern border adjoining Suozhuo.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，金川平定，於雅州建城，命提督移駐，增兵六千五百人，分守沿邊。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year, the Jin River region was pacified; a city was built at Yazhou, the provincial commander ordered to move his headquarters, six thousand five hundred troops added and distributed along the border.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year, after the Jin River region was pacified, a city was built at Yazhou, the provincial commander was moved there, and six thousand five hundred more troops were distributed along the frontier.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，設懋功、綏靖、崇化、撫邊、慶寧五營，制同內地，隸松潘鎮總兵，以控番徼。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year, Maogong, Suijing, Chonghua, Fubian, and Qingning five camps were established with the same system as the interior, under the Songpan garrison regional commander, to control tribal marches.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year, five camps—Maogong, Suijing, Chonghua, Fubian, and Qingning—were established on the interior model under the Songpan regional commander to control the tribal marches.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，特成額因川邊外之察木多，曾設游擊等弁兵，控制西藏。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year, Techeng'e, because Chamdo beyond the Sichuan border had once had mobile corps and other officers and troops controlling Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year, Techeng'e noted that Chamdo beyond the Sichuan frontier had once been held by a mobile corps and other troops to control Tibet.

sentences.zh: 今藏事敉平，乃抽撥營兵，移防江卡，增築碉房，並於三暗巴一帶，設守備等官。

translations.literal: Now Tibetan affairs were pacified; camp troops were drawn and shifted to garrison Jiangka, blockhouses increased, and at San'anba and the surrounding area garrison commandants and other officers were established.
translations.idiomatic: With Tibetan affairs now settled, camp troops were redeployed to Jiangka, blockhouses were strengthened, and garrison commandants were posted in the San'anba district.

sentences.zh: 道光十三年，以副將率兵二千人，駐大樹堡，濬濠建碉，兼防河道。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Daoguang, a deputy commander leading two thousand troops was garrisoned at Dashubao, moats dredged and blockhouses built, also guarding the river route.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Daoguang, a deputy commander with two thousand men was posted at Dashubao, where moats were dredged and blockhouses built to guard the river route as well.

sentences.zh: 以松潘屯千九百人，歸併峨邊。

translations.literal: The Songpan garrison colony's one thousand nine hundred men were merged into Ebian.
translations.idiomatic: One thousand nine hundred troops from the Songpan garrison colony were reassigned to Ebian.

sentences.zh: 十九年，因川邊防兵僅四千餘人，不敷防守，於馬邊、雷波、越巂、峨邊、屏山各廳縣增兵二千人，增練兵千六百人，改營制，修碉堡，★飭鎮道各員，於秋冬分巡邊界。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, because Sichuan frontier defense troops were only a little more than four thousand and insufficient for defense, at Mabian, Leibo, Yuexi, Ebian, Pingshan, and other departments and counties two thousand troops were added and drilled troops sixteen hundred added, the camp system was changed, blockhouses were repaired, and the regional commanders and circuit intendants were ordered that in autumn and winter they should separately patrol the border.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, because fewer than four thousand men guarded the Sichuan marches—too few to hold the line—two thousand regulars and sixteen hundred drilled troops were added across the departments and counties of Mabian, Leibo, Yuexi, Ebian, and Pingshan. The camp organization was revised, blockhouses were repaired, and regional commanders and circuit intendants were ordered to make separate border inspections each autumn and winter.

sentences.zh: 尋以馬邊等廳，夷匪不靖，命大臣齊慎親往籌防。

translations.literal: Soon, because at Mabian and other departments Yi bandits were not tranquil, the minister Qi Shen was ordered to go in person to plan defense.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, unrest among Yi bandits in Mabian and neighboring departments led the court to dispatch Minister Qi Shen in person to organize frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 同治十二年，因峨邊廳蠻族投誠，擇充千、百戶等職，編製夷兵，建修碉堡。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Tongzhi, because at Ebian Department tribal peoples submitted, they were selected and filled thousand-household and hundred-household posts and other offices, tribal troops were organized, and blockhouses were built and repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Tongzhi, after tribes in Ebian Department submitted, chieftains were appointed as thousand- and hundred-household officers, tribal militia were organized, and blockhouses were built and repaired.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十三年，鹿傳霖以三瞻地接里塘，為入藏北界，擬設定瞻直隸廳，而移建昌道於打箭爐，仿金川五屯之制，設立屯官及將弁汛兵，並接展電線至前藏。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Guangxu, Lu Chuanlin, because Sanzhan adjoins Litang and is the northern border for entering Tibet, proposed establishing Sanzhan as a directly administered department and moving the Jianchang circuit to Dajianlu, imitating the Jinchuan five-garrison-colony system to establish colony officials and officers with flood-garrison troops, and also extending telegraph lines to front Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of Guangxu, Lu Chuanlin argued that Sanzhan, adjoining Litang, formed the northern gateway into Tibet. He proposed making it a directly administered department, relocating the Jianchang circuit to Dajianlu, and following the Jinchuan five-colony model by appointing colony officials and garrison officers with outpost troops, while extending telegraph lines into front Tibet.

sentences.zh: 其事議而未行。

translations.literal: That matter was discussed but not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was debated but never implemented.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，部臣議裁★邊防軍，趙爾豐以川邊原有巡防五營，已屬不敷調遣，遂定議緩裁。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, ministry officials proposed reducing the frontier defense army; Zhao Erfeng, because the Sichuan border's original five patrol-defense camps were already insufficient for dispatch, then fixed the decision to defer reduction.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year, ministry officials proposed cutting frontier defense forces, but Zhao Erfeng noted that the five existing patrol camps on the Sichuan border were already overstretched, and the court agreed to postpone any reduction.

sentences.zh: 宣統初年，趙爾巽以打箭爐外所有改土歸流屬地，擬悉隸於邊務大臣，★增設官吏，寬籌經費，協濟兵食，以固邊圉。

translations.literal: In the early Xuantong period, Zhao Erxun, regarding all lands beyond Dajianlu brought under direct rule after replacing native chieftains, proposed that all be subordinated to the border affairs minister, with additional officials established, funds broadly provided, military provisions jointly supplied, to secure the border enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xuantong reign, Zhao Erxun proposed placing all territories beyond Dajianlu that had been brought under direct administration under the border affairs commissioner, establishing additional officials, allocating ample funds, and coordinating military supplies to strengthen the frontier.

sentences.zh: 三年，趙爾豐收回三瞻，土司之梗化者，遂自請歸流雲。

translations.literal: In the third year, Zhao Erfeng recovered Sanzhan; native chieftains who had been obstinate then themselves requested direct rule.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Zhao Erfeng recovered Sanzhan, after which recalcitrant native chieftains themselves petitioned to submit to direct administration.

sentences.zh: 雲南沿邊，環接外夷，南境之蒙自，當越南國，西南境之騰越，當緬甸國，尤為南維鎖鑰。

translations.literal: Yunnan's along-border region on all sides adjoins outer tribes; on the southern border Mengzi faces the state of Vietnam, and on the southwest border Tengyue faces the state of Burma—especially the southern sustaining lock and key.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan's frontier encircles foreign peoples on every side. Mengzi on the south faces Vietnam, and Tengyue on the southwest faces Burma; together they formed the southern keys to the realm.

sentences.zh: 騰越界連野番，舊設八關九隘，以土練駐防。

translations.literal: Tengyue's border connects with wild tribes; formerly eight passes and nine barriers were established, with native militia garrisoned for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Tengyue bordered wild tribal lands, where eight passes and nine barriers had long been manned by native militia.

sentences.zh: 緬甸國入貢之道，向由虎踞關入，經孟卯、隴川等處，以達南甸，設南營都司以備之。

translations.literal: The Burma state's tribute route had always entered through Huju Pass, passing Mengmao, Longchuan, and other places to reach Nandian; a South Camp company commander was established to guard it.
translations.idiomatic: Burma's tribute mission had traditionally entered through Huju Pass, passed through Mengmao and Longchuan, and reached Nandian, where a South Camp company commander was posted as a precaution.

sentences.zh: 自外海輪舶南來，直抵新街，商賈咸趨北道，由騰城西南行，經南甸、千崖、盞達三宣撫司，歷四程而至蠻允，過此即野人境。

translations.literal: Since steamships from the outer sea came south straight to Xinjie, merchants all rushed to the northern route, from Tengcheng going southwest, passing Nandian and the three Pacification Commissionerates of Qianya, Zhanda, and taking four stages to reach Manyun—beyond that is wild tribes' territory.
translations.idiomatic: Once steamers from overseas sailed south to Xinjie, merchants favored the northern route southwest from Tengcheng through Nandian and the Pacification Commissionerates of Qianya and Zhanda. Four stages brought them to Manyun, beyond which lay tribal country.

sentences.zh: 其間有三路。

translations.literal: Between them are three routes.
translations.idiomatic: Three routes ran between them.

sentences.zh: 下為河邊路，中為石梯路，上為炎山路。

translations.literal: Below is the riverside route, in the middle the stone-ladder route, above the Yanshan route.
translations.idiomatic: The lower route followed the riverbank, the middle route the stone ladder path, and the upper route the Yanshan trail.

sentences.zh: 下路較近，上路則柴草咸便，行四日至蠻暮，入緬甸界。

translations.literal: The lower route is comparatively nearer; the upper route then has firewood and grass all convenient; traveling four days reaches Manmu and enters Burma's border.
translations.idiomatic: The lower road was shorter, while the upper road offered ample fuel and forage. Four days' travel reached Manmu and the Burmese frontier.

sentences.zh: 舟行一日，可達新街。

translations.literal: By boat one day's travel can reach Xinjie.
translations.idiomatic: A day's sail downstream also reached Xinjie.

sentences.zh: 又印度東境之野山，系珞瑜番族，英吉利人由印度侵入，闢地種茶桑，其地可通孟養而達騰越，邊外強鄰野俗，錯處可虞。

translations.literal: Moreover, the wild mountains of India's eastern border belong to the Luoyu tribal peoples; English people invaded from India, opened land and planted tea and mulberry; that land can connect through Mengyang to reach Tengyue—beyond the border powerful neighbors and wild customs mixed in places give cause for concern.
translations.idiomatic: In the wild hills of eastern India lived the Luoyu tribes. The British advanced from India, cleared land, and planted tea and mulberry. The region linked Mengyang with Tengyue, and the mingling of powerful neighbors and tribal customs beyond the border gave cause for alarm.

sentences.zh: 明代舊置銅壁、巨石、萬仞諸關，以固邊圉。

translations.literal: In the Ming period old establishments of Tongbi, Jushi, Wanyin, and other passes were made to secure the border enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming, passes such as Tongbi, Jushi, and Wanyin had been built to secure the frontier.

sentences.zh: 水道則海珀江自千崖以下，水勢漸寬，與大金沙江合流，元代征緬甸，以舟師制勝，取建瓴之勢也。

translations.literal: On the water route, the Haipo River from below Qianya gradually widens in current and joins the great Jinsha River; the Yuan dynasty's campaign against Burma used naval forces to achieve victory, taking the advantage of water pouring from a high house.
translations.idiomatic: By water, the Haipo River below Qianya broadened and joined the great Jinsha. The Yuan conquest of Burma had relied on a fleet to gain the upper hand from downstream—literally, the vantage of water tipped from the eaves.

sentences.zh: 其永昌、順寧、大理三府，及蒙化一廳，楚雄府之姚州，皆迤西邊界，山深箐密，漢、夷雜處。

translations.literal: Its Yongchang, Shunning, and Dali three prefectures, and one Menghua department, and Chuxiong Prefecture's Yaozhou—all are the far-western border, mountains deep and ravines dense, Han and tribes mixed in residence.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchang, Shunning, and Dali prefectures, the department of Menghua, and Yaozhou in Chuxiong all lay on the far-western frontier, where deep mountains and narrow ravines sheltered mixed Han and tribal populations.

sentences.zh: 清初原設永順鎮總兵，迨改鎮為協，僅於永昌城駐兵，沿邊一帶，有鞭長莫及之虞。

translations.literal: In the early Qing a Yongshun garrison regional commander was originally established; when the garrison was changed to a brigade, troops were garrisoned only at Yongchang city, and along the border belt there was fear of a whip too short to reach the horse.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qing a regional commander had been posted at Yongshun, but when the garrison was reduced to a brigade only Yongchang city held troops, leaving the long frontier line beyond effective control.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，青海平定，於鴉龍江各處，設副將等官，宗鄱地方，當雲南孔道，設參將等官，以靖邊服。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng, Qinghai was pacified; at various places on the Yalong River deputy commanders and other officers were established; at Zongpo, facing Yunnan's main thoroughfare, brigade commanders and other officers were established to quiet the border submission.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongzheng, after Qinghai was pacified, deputy commanders were posted along the Yalong River and brigade commanders at Zongpo on Yunnan's main route to settle the frontier.

sentences.zh: 三年，因威遠大山為苗、裸盤踞之所，乃於普茶山各處，設參將等官，兵丁千二百人，並於九龍江口設立防汛。

translations.literal: In the third year, because Weiyuan's great mountains were a place where Miao and Luo entrenched themselves, at various places on Puchashan brigade commanders and other officers were established with twelve hundred soldiers, and at Jiulong River mouth a flood garrison was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, because Miao and Luo bands held the great mountains of Weiyuan, brigade commanders with twelve hundred men were stationed around Puchashan and an outpost was placed at the mouth of the Jiulong River.

sentences.zh: 四年，以四川阿墩子地方當中甸門戶，移其防汛歸雲南省管轄，與里塘、打箭爐相為犄角。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, because Sichuan's Adunzi region faces Zhongdian's gateway, its flood garrison was moved under Yunnan Province's jurisdiction, forming horns with Litang and Dajianlu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Adunzi in Sichuan, guarding the gateway to Zhongdian, was placed under Yunnan's jurisdiction so that its garrison could support Litang and Dajianlu in a pincer.

sentences.zh: 五年，以中甸延袤千里，為滇省西南籓籬，維西乃通西藏要隘，增設參將營於中甸，守備營於維西。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, because Zhongdian extends a thousand li and is Yunnan Province's southwest fence and screen, and Weixi is the vital pass connecting to Tibet, a brigade-commander camp was added at Zhongdian and a garrison-commandant camp at Weixi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Zhongdian's thousand-li expanse was recognized as Yunnan's southwestern bulwark and Weixi as the critical pass to Tibet; a brigade-commander camp was added at Zhongdian and a garrison-commandant camp at Weixi.

sentences.zh: 六年，因烏蒙、鎮雄二處地方遼闊，於烏蒙設總兵等官，鎮雄設參將等官，分隘駐防。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, because Wumeng and Zhenxiong two places were broad in territory, at Wumeng a regional commander and other officers were established, at Zhenxiong brigade commanders and other officers, divided among passes for garrison defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, the vast districts of Wumeng and Zhenxiong received a regional commander at Wumeng and a brigade commander at Zhenxiong, with troops distributed among the mountain passes.

sentences.zh: 所有舊設之貴州威寧營，雲南鎮雄營、東川營咸隸烏蒙鎮總兵調遣，建築城垣。

translations.literal: All formerly established Guizhou Weining Camp, Yunnan Zhenxiong Camp, and Dongchuan Camp were placed under the Wumeng garrison regional commander's dispatch, and city walls were built.
translations.idiomatic: The existing camps of Weining in Guizhou and Zhenxiong and Dongchuan in Yunnan were all placed under the Wumeng regional commander, and city walls were constructed.

sentences.zh: 旋增兵千五百人，設尋甸州參將等官。

translations.literal: Soon fifteen hundred troops were added and a Xundian Prefecture brigade commander and other officers were established.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen hundred more troops were soon added and a brigade commander was posted at Xundian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 七年，設普洱府及普洱鎮將，標兵三千二百人，分防各路。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Pu'er Prefecture and the Pu'er garrison commander were established, with three thousand two hundred standard troops divided to defend the various routes.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Pu'er Prefecture and its garrison commander were established, and thirty-two hundred standard troops were distributed along the main routes.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十二年，以木邦為通緬甸要路，並九龍江、隴川、黑山門各隘，咸以兵駐守。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Qianlong, because Mubang is the vital route to Burma, together with Jiulong River, Longchuan, Heishanmen, and each pass, all were garrisoned with troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year of Qianlong, Mubang as the main route into Burma and the passes at the Jiulong River, Longchuan, and Heishanmen were all manned with troops.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，李侍堯因永昌、普洱等府，向以鎮、協標千五百人，在三台山、龍江一帶駐營防緬，冬去春回，頗形煩累。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year, Li Shiyao, because Yongchang, Pu'er, and other prefectures had always used garrison and brigade standards of fifteen hundred men to camp at Santai Mountain and the Long River belt to defend against Burma, leaving in winter and returning in spring, was quite troublesome in form.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-third year, Li Shiyao noted that Yongchang, Pu'er, and other prefectures had long rotated fifteen hundred garrison and brigade troops between Santai Mountain and the Long River to guard against Burma, withdrawing each winter and returning each spring—a burdensome arrangement.

sentences.zh: 雲南省控制全邊，重在騰越。

translations.literal: Yunnan Province's control of the whole border weighs heavily on Tengyue.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan's control of the entire frontier hinged on Tengyue.

sentences.zh: 其南甸之東南為杉木籠，距虎踞關百餘里，當騰越左臂。

translations.literal: Southeast of its Nandian is Shanmulong, more than a hundred li from Huju Pass, facing Tengyue's left arm.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast of Nandian lay Shanmulong, a hundred-odd li from Huju Pass, forming Tengyue's left flank.

sentences.zh: 南甸之西南為千崖，距銅壁、萬仞、神護、巨石諸關，均一二百里，實為各路咽喉。

translations.literal: Southwest of Nandian is Qianya, from Tongbi, Wanyin, Shenhu, Jushi, and other passes each one or two hundred li—truly the throat of the various routes.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of Nandian stood Qianya, one to two hundred li from the passes of Tongbi, Wanyin, Shenhu, and Jushi—the throat of every route.

sentences.zh: 乃於杉木籠、千崖二處各增將弁營汛。

translations.literal: Then at Shanmulong and Qianya two places each added officers, camps, and flood garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Officers, camps, and outposts were therefore added at both Shanmulong and Qianya.

sentences.zh: 龍陵地方，道通木邦，原駐兵千五百人，其南三台山尤為扼要，亦增設弁兵。

translations.literal: Longling region's route connects to Mubang; originally fifteen hundred troops were garrisoned; its south Santai Mountain is especially a choke point, and officers and troops were also added.
translations.idiomatic: Longling, on the road to Mubang, already held fifteen hundred men; Santai Mountain to the south was especially critical, and more officers and troops were posted there.

sentences.zh: 以順寧一路舊有之額兵，分駐緬寧，與永順右營協同防守。

translations.literal: The Shunning route's old quota troops were divided to garrison at Mianning, jointly defending with the Yongshun Right Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: Existing troops on the Shunning route were redeployed to Mianning to defend jointly with the Yongshun Right Brigade.

sentences.zh: 總督、提、鎮大員，每年酌赴騰越邊外巡閱一周，以期嚴密。

translations.literal: The governor-general, provincial commander, and garrison great officers each year appropriately went to Tengyue beyond the border to inspect a circuit, in order to seek strictness.
translations.idiomatic: Each year the governor-general, provincial commander, and regional commanders made a discretionary tour beyond Tengyue to tighten frontier discipline.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十七年，以雲南邊外野夷裸匪肆擾，而緬寧、騰越各隘，皆瘴癘之地，難駐官兵，復設土練兵一千六百人，以八百人駐守緬寧之丙野山樑等處，八百人駐守騰越之蠻章山等處，省官兵徵調之勞。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Jiaqing, because beyond Yunnan's border wild tribes and Luo bandits ran riot, yet Mianning and Tengyue each pass were all miasma lands difficult for regular troops to garrison, native militia of sixteen hundred were again established—eight hundred garrisoned at Mianning's Bingye Shanliang and other places, eight hundred at Tengyue's Manzhang Mountain and other places—to spare regular troops' dispatch labor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Jiaqing, wild tribes and Luo bandits harassed the Yunnan frontier, while the passes around Mianning and Tengyue were too malarial for regular garrisons. Sixteen hundred native militia were therefore restored—eight hundred at Bingye Shanliang near Mianning and eight hundred at Manzhang Mountain near Tengyue—relieving regular troops of constant dispatch.

sentences.zh: 道光間，林則徐於迤西移改協、營，增設弁兵。

translations.literal: During the Daoguang period, Lin Zexu in the far west moved and changed brigades and camps and added officers and troops.
translations.idiomatic: During the Daoguang era, Lin Zexu reorganized brigades and camps in far western Yunnan and increased officer strength.

sentences.zh: 其扼要之處，為永平縣、永昌府龍街汛、永定汛、漾濞汛、姚關汛等，凡二十一汛，咸增兵駐防，而瀾滄江橋尤為扼險。

translations.literal: Its choke points were Yongping County, Yongchang Prefecture's Longjie, Yongding, Yangbi, and Yaoguan flood garrisons and others—in all twenty-one flood garrisons, all with added troops garrisoned for defense, and the Lancang River bridge was especially a choke danger.
translations.idiomatic: Critical posts included Yongping County and the outposts at Longjie, Yongding, Yangbi, and Yaoguan in Yongchang—twenty-one in all—each reinforced, with the Lancang River bridge the most formidable choke point.

sentences.zh: 順寧府毗連夷地，以龍陵協與順寧參將對調。

translations.literal: Shunning Prefecture adjoins tribal lands; the Longling Brigade and Shunning brigade commander were exchanged in posting.
translations.idiomatic: Because Shunning Prefecture bordered tribal territory, the Longling Brigade and the Shunning brigade commander exchanged posts.

sentences.zh: 緬寧廳、錫臘、右甸、阿魯、史塘等處防軍，或分汛多而存城少，或分汛少而存城多，地之夷險與兵之多少不均，咸酌量增調。

translations.literal: Mianning Department, Xila, Youdian, Alu, Shitang, and other places' defense troops—some had many divided flood garrisons but few kept in the city, some few divided flood garrisons but many kept in the city; the land's tribal danger and troops' numbers were uneven—all were measured and increased or shifted.
translations.idiomatic: Defensive dispositions at Mianning Department, Xila, Youdian, Alu, Shitang, and elsewhere were uneven—some posts were thinly held in the city, others over-garrisoned in the field relative to tribal risk—and troops were adjusted accordingly.

sentences.zh: 大理府原駐提督，而上下二關，及太和縣城、彌渡、紅岩、趙州等處，尚屬空虛，均增兵填防。

translations.literal: Dali Prefecture originally garrisoned the provincial commander, yet the upper and lower two passes, and Taihe county seat, Midu, Hongyan, Zhaozhou, and other places still belonged to emptiness—all had troops added to fill defense.
translations.idiomatic: Although the provincial commander was based at Dali Prefecture, the upper and lower passes and Taihe, Midu, Hongyan, Zhaozhou, and other points remained undermanned and received reinforcing garrisons.

sentences.zh: 姚州、蒙化二處，亦改汛增兵。

translations.literal: Yaozhou and Menghua two places also changed flood garrisons and increased troops.
translations.idiomatic: Outposts at Yaozhou and Menghua were likewise reorganized and reinforced.

sentences.zh: 同治間，雲南平定，岑毓英因迤西麗江府城地處極邊，界連西藏，麗江、劍川交界之喇雞鳴地方，系江邊要隘，江外即野人境，向未設兵。

translations.literal: During Tongzhi, Yunnan was pacified; Cen Yuying, because far-western Lijiang prefecture city is at the extreme border adjoining Tibet, and at Lijiang and Jianchuan's border place Lajiming is a riverside vital pass—with beyond the river wild tribes' territory—troops had never been established.
translations.idiomatic: After Yunnan was pacified in the Tongzhi era, Cen Yuying noted that Lijiang on the far western frontier bordered Tibet. Lajiming on the Lijiang–Jianchuan border was a critical riverside pass facing tribal country beyond the river, yet had never been garrisoned.

sentences.zh: 乃以麗鶴鎮都司移駐麗江府，劍川營都司移駐喇雞鳴。

translations.literal: Then the Lihu garrison company commander was moved to garrison Lijiang Prefecture, and the Jianchuan Camp company commander was moved to garrison Lajiming.
translations.idiomatic: The Lihu garrison company commander was therefore relocated to Lijiang Prefecture and the Jianchuan Camp company commander to Lajiming.

sentences.zh: 此外楚雄府屬之八哨地方三、四百里間，裸夷雜居，亦系要地，令楚雄協副將設汛駐兵。

translations.literal: Moreover, within Chuxiong Prefecture's subordinate Baxiao region's three or four hundred li, Luo tribes mixed in residence—it was also a vital place—and the Chuxiong Brigade deputy commander was ordered to establish flood garrisons and garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: In Baxiao under Chuxiong Prefecture, stretching three or four hundred li where Luo tribes lived intermixed, the Chuxiong Brigade deputy commander was likewise ordered to establish outposts.

sentences.zh: 十三年，以昭通標兵之半，赴金沙江外駐守。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, half of Zhaotong's standard troops went beyond the Jinsha River to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, half of Zhaotong's standard troops were posted beyond the Jinsha River.

sentences.zh: 光緒七年，劉長佑因劍川城地當孔道，為迤西要區，以喇井營移駐劍川。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Guangxu, Liu Changyou, because Jianchuan city faces the main thoroughfare and is a vital far-western region, moved the Lajing Camp to garrison Jianchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Guangxu, Liu Changyou moved the Lajing Camp to Jianchuan, a key junction on the main route through the far west.

sentences.zh: 喇井亦瀾滄江要地，以吉尾汛移駐，互相會哨。

translations.literal: Lajing is also a Lancang River vital place; the Jiwei flood garrison was moved to garrison there, mutually meeting for watch.
translations.idiomatic: Lajing was another critical point on the Lancang, so the Jiwei outpost was moved there to coordinate patrols with Jianchuan.

sentences.zh: 十一年，岑毓英因滇省入越南之路，以白馬關為要，法蘭西人通商之路，以蒙自縣為沖，沿邊千里，處處錯壤，留防之兵一萬六千人，編為三十營，以白馬關隸開化鎮總兵，蒙自隸臨元鎮總兵，每年瘴消之際，親赴邊陲，簡閱營伍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Cen Yuying, because Yunnan Province's route into Vietnam takes Baima Pass as vital and the French people's trade route takes Mengzi County as the rush point, along the border a thousand li with everywhere interlocking territory, retained defense troops of sixteen thousand organized into thirty camps—Baima Pass subordinated to the Kaihua garrison regional commander, Mengzi to the Linyuan garrison regional commander—and each year when miasma cleared, personally went to the border marches to review camps.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Cen Yuying held that Baima Pass guarded the route into Vietnam while Mengzi formed the hub of French trade. Along a thousand li of interlocking frontier, sixteen thousand troops in thirty camps were retained—Baima under the Kaihua regional commander and Mengzi under the Linyuan regional commander—and each year, when the miasma season ended, he personally inspected the border forces.

sentences.zh: 箇舊錫廠，規制宏大，廠丁數萬人，漢、夷雜處，且通三猛、蠻耗各路，乃增設同知一員，移臨元之都司營兵駐防箇舊，調原駐開化游擊移守白馬關，以右營都司分防古林，移右營守備駐長岡嶺，以臨元游擊駐蒙自縣，右營都司分防水田，右營守備分防嵩田，為因地制宜之計。

translations.literal: Gejiu's tin works were grand in scale, with tens of thousands of workers, Han and tribes mixed, and also connecting the routes of Sanmeng and Manhao; thus one subprefect was added, Linyuan's company-commander camp troops were moved to garrison Gejiu, the originally garrisoned Kaihua mobile corps was shifted to guard Baima Pass, the Right Brigade company commander divided defense at Gulin, the Right Brigade garrison commandant was moved to garrison Changgangling, the Linyuan mobile corps garrisoned Mengzi County, the Right Brigade company commander divided defense at Shuitian, the Right Brigade garrison commandant divided defense at Songtian—as a plan adapting measures to local conditions.
translations.idiomatic: Gejiu's vast tin works employed tens of thousands of Han and tribal workers and opened routes to Sanmeng and Manhao. A subprefect was added, Linyuan troops were posted to Gejiu, the Kaikai mobile corps to Baima Pass, the Right Brigade company commander to Gulin, its garrison commandant to Changgangling, the Linyuan mobile corps to Mengzi, and other Right Brigade detachments to Shuitian and Songtian—a disposition tailored to local needs.

sentences.zh: 自雲南入緬甸，共有六途，以蠻允一途為捷徑，沿邊由西而南而東，皆野人山寨，布列於九隘之外，兵團守望，時虞不足。

translations.literal: From Yunnan into Burma there are in all six routes; the Manyun route is the shortcut; along the border from west to south to east are all wild tribes' stockaded villages arrayed outside the nine barriers—troops and militia on watch, at times feared insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Six routes led from Yunnan into Burma, Manyun being the shortest. Tribal stockades lined the frontier from west to south to east beyond the nine barriers, and the troops and militia on watch were often feared inadequate.

sentences.zh: 乃調關外勁旅二千餘人，與原有防軍及鄉團、土司，協力警備。

translations.literal: Then more than two thousand crack troops from beyond the passes were shifted, together with original defense troops, village militia, and native chieftains, jointly to warn and guard.
translations.idiomatic: More than two thousand seasoned troops from beyond the passes were therefore deployed alongside existing garrisons, village militia, and native chieftains for joint patrol.

sentences.zh: 十四年，岑毓英以邊境裸黑夷匪，頻年滋事，分別剿撫。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Cen Yuying, because borderland Luohei Yi bandits for successive years raised affairs, separately suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, Cen Yuying suppressed and pacified Luohei Yi bandits who had troubled the border for years.

sentences.zh: 裸黑所屯踞之地，分上下改心，在瀾滄江畔，界接土司，其東西大路，與緬甸逼處，為順寧、普洱兩府屏蔽，其下改心地方，尤為扼要。

translations.literal: The place where Luohei entrenched themselves was divided into Upper and Lower Gaixin, on the Lancang River's bank, bordering native chieftains; its east-west great routes pressed close to Burma and were a screen for Shunning and Pu'er two prefectures—its Lower Gaixin region was especially a choke point.
translations.idiomatic: Luohei strongholds lay in Upper and Lower Gaixin on the Lancang, adjoining native chieftaincies. Their east–west routes hugged the Burmese frontier and shielded Shunning and Pu'er, with Lower Gaixin the most critical.

sentences.zh: 乃增設鎮邊撫夷廳，擇地建築城垣，並設參將等官，駐防兵丁一千一百五十八人。

translations.literal: Then the Border-Pacifying Tribal-Subduing Department was added, a site chosen to build city walls, and brigade commanders and other officers established, with garrison troops of one thousand one hundred fifty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: A Border-Pacifying Tribal Affairs department was therefore established, walls were built on a chosen site, a brigade commander was appointed, and 1,158 troops were stationed.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，鹿傳霖以維西協所屬阿墩子汛地，界接川邊之巴塘，左臨瀾滄江，右挹金沙江，地勢至要，英緬鐵路所經，相距漸近，僅四、五日程。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, Lu Chuanlin, regarding the Weixi Brigade's subordinate Adunzi flood-garrison territory—bordering Sichuan border's Batang, left facing the Lancang River, right drawing on the Jinsha River, terrain of utmost importance, where the Anglo-Burmese railway passes, the distance gradually near, only four or five days' journey.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, Lu Chuanlin stressed that Adunzi under the Weixi Brigade adjoined Batang on the Sichuan border, flanked by the Lancang and Jinsha rivers—a position of the highest importance now that the Anglo-Burmese railway lay only four or five days away.

sentences.zh: 乃協商四川疆臣，酌設重鎮，並於川、滇交界處，兩省各設文武員弁，協力防邊。

translations.literal: Then he consulted with Sichuan's frontier minister to measure and establish a weighty garrison, and at the Sichuan–Yunnan border place each province established civil and military officers to cooperate in defending the border.
translations.idiomatic: He then consulted Sichuan's frontier governor on establishing a major garrison and posting civil and military officers on both sides of the provincial border for joint defense.

sentences.zh: 雲南自英據緬甸，法奪越南，防守兩難。

translations.literal: Yunnan, since Britain occupied Burma and France seized Vietnam, had defense doubly difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Once Britain held Burma and France seized Vietnam, Yunnan faced defense on two fronts.

sentences.zh: 光緒之季，西南騰越、臨安兩路，創設團練，稍資捍衛。

translations.literal: At the end of Guangxu, on the southwest Tengyue and Lin'an two routes, militia training was newly established, slightly supplying defense.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Guangxu reign, militia were organized on the Tengyue and Lin'an routes in the southwest, offering modest local defense.

sentences.zh: 而餉絀兵單，邊防漸弛矣。

translations.literal: Yet pay was short and troops few—the frontier defense gradually slackened.
translations.idiomatic: Yet pay fell short, troops were thin, and the frontier defenses gradually weakened.

sentences.zh: 廣東邊防，海重於陸。

translations.literal: Guangdong frontier defense: the sea weighs heavier than the land.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong's frontier defense weighed the sea more heavily than the land.

sentences.zh: 同治十三年，越南不靖，督臣瑞麟慮其越界，以防勇二千人扼守欽州。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Tongzhi, Vietnam was not tranquil; Governor Rui Lin feared it would cross the border and used two thousand defense braves to choke-hold Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Tongzhi, unrest in Vietnam led Governor Rui Lin to fear incursions and post two thousand defense braves at Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 光緒八年，曾國荃因欽州之東興街，地接越南，撥勁兵二營駐守，續撥老勇三營助之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Guangxu, Zeng Guoquan, because Qinzhou's Dongxing Street adjoins Vietnam, allocated two crack camps to garrison, and afterward allocated three veteran-brave camps to assist.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Guangxu, Zeng Guoquan posted two elite battalions at Dongxing Street in Qinzhou on the Vietnamese border and later added three veteran battalions.

sentences.zh: 十年，法蘭西侵奪越南，彭玉麟督辦粵防，以欽州與廉州並重，增調營勇赴欽、廉，恐地廣兵單，以團練協守。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, France invaded and seized Vietnam; Peng Yulin supervised Guangdong defense, taking Qinzhou and Lianzhou as equally weighty, increasing and shifting camp braves to Qin and Lian, fearing broad territory and few troops, using militia training to assist defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, after France seized Vietnam, Peng Yulin oversaw Guangdong's defenses, treating Qinzhou and Lianzhou as equally vital. More battalions were sent to both prefectures, and militia were enlisted to help cover the wide ground with few regulars.

sentences.zh: 至省內防務，則有三江口之排瑤，瓊、崖之黎匪，時或出巢滋事。

translations.literal: As for defense within the province, there were Sanjiangkou's Pai Yao, and Qiong and Ya's Li bandits, at times leaving their nests to raise affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Within the province, Pai Yao at Sanjiangkou and Li bandits in Qiong and Ya occasionally left their strongholds to make trouble.

sentences.zh: 排瑤山境四百餘里，康熙四十一年，於瑤境適中之三江口，設立寨城，置副將等官，兵丁千餘人。

translations.literal: Pai Yao mountain territory is more than four hundred li; in the forty-first year of Kangxi, at the Yao territory's suitable middle point Sanjiangkou, a stockade city was established, with deputy commanders and other officers placed and more than a thousand soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Pai Yao territory stretched four hundred li. In the forty-first year of Kangxi a walled stockade was built at Sanjiangkou in the heart of the region, garrisoned by a deputy commander and over a thousand troops.
