sentences.zh: 道光十二年，增三江口戍兵二千人，建築碉台，以控制悍瑤。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Daoguang, Sanjiangkou garrison troops were increased by two thousand, blockhouse platforms were built to control fierce Yao.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Daoguang, two thousand more troops were added at Sanjiangkou and blockhouse platforms built to restrain the warlike Yao.

sentences.zh: 光緒十三年，張之洞剿平瓊州黎匪，山路開通，收撫黎眾十萬人，定撫黎章程十二條。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Guangxu, Zhang Zhidong suppressed and pacified Qiongzhou's Li bandits, mountain routes were opened, one hundred thousand Li people were received and pacified, and twelve articles of regulations for pacifying the Li were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Guangxu, Zhang Zhidong suppressed Li rebels in Qiongzhou, opened mountain roads, brought a hundred thousand Li under administration, and issued twelve regulations for their governance.

sentences.zh: 粵省負山帶海，西來歐舶，首及粵洋，陸路僅欽、廉一路當敵，防戍較易於海疆也。

translations.literal: Guangdong Province bears mountains and girds the sea; European ships coming from the west first reach Guangdong's ocean; on land only the Qin and Lian route faces the enemy—garrison defense is comparatively easier than the sea frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong lay between mountains and sea; European vessels reached its coast first. On land only the Qinzhou–Lianzhou corridor faced the enemy, making land defense somewhat easier than coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 廣西南邊，綿亙千餘里，原設隘所百有九處，分卡六十六處，與越南之諒山、高平、宣光等處接壤。

translations.literal: Guangxi's southern border extends continuously more than a thousand li; originally established were one hundred nine barrier posts, divided into sixty-six checkpoint stations, bordering Vietnam's Lang Son, Cao Bang, Xuan Quang, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi's southern frontier ran more than a thousand li, with 109 barrier posts and 66 checkpoints along the border with Vietnam's provinces of Lang Son, Cao Bang, and Xuan Quang.

sentences.zh: 叢山密箐中，小徑咸通。

translations.literal: Amid clustered mountains and dense ravines, small paths all connect through.
translations.idiomatic: Dense mountains and ravines were crisscrossed by footpaths.

sentences.zh: 鎮南關至龍州一路，地較寬平，為中越商旅通衢，東出太平、南寧，西出歸順、鎮安之總匯。

translations.literal: From Zhennan Pass to Longzhou one route—the land comparatively broad and level—is the main thoroughfare for China–Vietnam merchants and travelers, the general convergence east to Taiping and Nanning, west to Guishun and Zhen'an.
translations.idiomatic: The route from Zhennan Pass to Longzhou was relatively open and served as the main artery for Sino-Vietnamese trade, linking Taiping and Nanning to the east with Guishun and Zhen'an to the west.

sentences.zh: 自龍州以東，下水直達梧、潯，有建瓴之勢。

translations.literal: From Longzhou eastward, going downstream straight reaches Wu and Xun, with the advantage of water pouring from a high house.
translations.idiomatic: East of Longzhou, downstream waters ran straight to Wuzhou and Xunzhou, giving the strategic advantage of holding the upper reaches.

sentences.zh: 歷朝南籓向化，自清初至道光、咸豐間，惟於龍憑營所轄水陸各隘口，以戍兵及沿邊土司協力防守。

translations.literal: Through the dynasties the southern vassals turned toward civilization; from the early Qing to the Daoguang and Xianfeng periods, only at the Longping Camp's jurisdiction over water and land each pass mouth were garrison troops and along-border native chieftains joined in defense.
translations.idiomatic: Southern vassals had long submitted to the throne. From the early Qing through Daoguang and Xianfeng, only the water and land passes under the Longping Camp were held by garrison troops with native chieftains along the border.

sentences.zh: 同治十一年，令馮子材等就戍所之鎮揀選各營，分佈各隘，是為防軍守邊之始。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Tongzhi, Feng Zicai and others were ordered at the garrison place's garrison to select each camp and distribute them among each pass—this was the beginning of defense troops guarding the border.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Tongzhi, Feng Zicai and others were ordered to select battalions from the garrison and distribute them among the passes—the beginning of regular frontier defense forces.

sentences.zh: 迨法、越戰事起，邊氛日亟，徵調頻煩，兵無久駐之地。

translations.literal: When the Franco-Vietnamese war arose, border atmosphere daily urgent, levies and dispatches frequent and troublesome—troops had no place for long garrison.
translations.idiomatic: When war broke out between France and Vietnam, border tensions mounted, levies were constant, and troops had no permanent stations.

sentences.zh: 光緒十二年，中、法款議既成，兩廣總督張之洞以鎮南一關，鈐轄中外，固屬極沖之地，即鎮南關之中後左右各路，亦須分兵設防。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Guangxu, after the Sino-French settlement was concluded, the Liangguang governor-general Zhang Zhidong, regarding Zhennan one pass as controlling inner and outer and solidly an extreme rush point—even Zhennan Pass's center, rear, left, and right routes—also required divided troops to set defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Guangxu, after the Sino-French settlement, Liangguang Governor-General Zhang Zhidong held that Zhennan Pass, commanding traffic between China and Vietnam, was the foremost choke point and that its center, rear, left, and right routes all required separate garrisons.

sentences.zh: 關以內之關南隘及憑祥土州為中路。

translations.literal: Inside the pass, Guannan Barrier and Pingxiang Native Department formed the center route.
translations.idiomatic: Inside the pass, Guannan Barrier and Pingxiang Native Department formed the central route.

sentences.zh: 自關以東，明江廳轄之由隘，寧明州轄之羅隘，思陵土州轄之愛店隘，上思州轄之百侖隘、剝機隘為東路。

translations.literal: From the pass eastward, Mingjiang Department's You Barrier, Ningming Prefecture's Luo Barrier, Siling Native Department's Aidian Barrier, and Shangsi Prefecture's Bailun and Boji barriers formed the east route.
translations.idiomatic: East of the pass lay the eastern route: You Barrier under Mingjiang Department, Luo Barrier under Ningming Prefecture, Aidian Barrier under Siling Native Department, and Bailun and Boji barriers under Shangsi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 自關以西，龍州廳轄之平西關、水口關，下凍土州轄之布局隘、梗花隘，歸順州轄之頻峒隘、龍邦隘，鎮安廳轄之猛峒隘、剝淰隘、百懷大隘等為西路。

translations.literal: From the pass westward, Longzhou Department's Pingxi Pass and Shuikou Pass, Xiadong Native Department's Buju and Genghua barriers, Guishun Prefecture's Pindong and Longbang barriers, and Zhen'an Department's Mengdong, Boqin, and Baihuai great barriers and others formed the west route.
translations.idiomatic: West of the pass lay the western route: Pingxi and Shuikou passes under Longzhou Department; Buju and Genghua barriers under Xiadong Native Department; Pindong and Longbang barriers under Guishun Prefecture; and Mengdong, Boqin, and Baihuai barriers under Zhen'an Department.

sentences.zh: 以上各隘，咸增兵屯守。

translations.literal: The above each barrier—all had troops added to garrison and hold.
translations.idiomatic: Troops were increased at all of these barriers.

sentences.zh: 以十二營防鎮南關中路，以四營防東路，六營防西路。

translations.literal: Twelve camps defended Zhennan Pass's center route, four camps the east route, six camps the west route.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve battalions guarded the central route at Zhennan Pass, four the eastern route, and six the western route.

sentences.zh: 其道路寬者，築台置砲；

translations.literal: Where routes were broad, platforms were built and cannon placed;
translations.idiomatic: On wider roads, platforms were built and cannon emplaced;

sentences.zh: 路窄者，設卡浚濠；

translations.literal: where routes were narrow, checkpoints were set and moats dredged;
translations.idiomatic: on narrow paths, checkpoints and ditches were dug;

sentences.zh: 甚僻者，則掘斷徑路，禁阻往來。

translations.literal: where extremely secluded, then paths were dug and cut off to forbid and block coming and going.
translations.idiomatic: and on the most remote trails, paths were cut and traffic forbidden.

sentences.zh: 豫造地營。

translations.literal: Earth camps were prepared in advance.
translations.idiomatic: Field entrenchments were prepared in advance.

sentences.zh: 無事則操練，有警則徵調赴援。

translations.literal: When no affair, then drill; when alarm, then levy and dispatch to aid.
translations.idiomatic: In peacetime the troops drilled; in an emergency they could be summoned to reinforce.

sentences.zh: 廣西提督由柳州移駐龍州，以控制邊夷。

translations.literal: Guangxi's provincial commander was moved from Liuzhou to garrison Longzhou, to control border tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangxi provincial commander was relocated from Liuzhou to Longzhou to oversee the border tribes.

sentences.zh: 而邊境過長，貴能扼要。

translations.literal: Yet the border was too long—what is valued is being able to choke the vital points.
translations.idiomatic: But the frontier was too long to guard everywhere; holding the key points mattered most.

sentences.zh: 關前隘為諒山來路，羅隘為間道所通，歸順之龍邦隘，鎮安之那坡隘，分扼牧馬、保樂夷寇來路，由隘當文淵之沖，即龍州後路，下凍土州通鎮邊聲息，令駐邊各將領，宜加嚴防。

translations.literal: Before-the-pass Barrier was Lang Son's coming route; Luo Barrier was where bypaths connect; Guishun's Longbang Barrier and Zhen'an's Napo Barrier separately choked the Muma and Baole tribal raiders' coming routes; You Barrier faced Wenyuan's rush point, namely Longzhou's rear route; Xiadong Native Department connected Zhenbian's news—border garrison generals were ordered to add strict defense.
translations.idiomatic: Guannan Barrier before the pass guarded the road from Lang Son; Luo Barrier covered a secret route; Longbang in Guishun and Napo in Zhen'an blocked tribal raids from Muma and Baole; You Barrier faced Wenyuan and protected Longzhou's rear; Xiadong linked intelligence from Zhenbian—border commanders were ordered to tighten their watch.

sentences.zh: 旋督臣張之洞以沿邊之新太協、上思營、鎮安協各營兵，或改勇補兵，或裁兵留勇，各就所宜，即分防之舉，為並省之謀。

translations.literal: Soon Governor Zhang Zhidong, regarding along-border Xintai Brigade, Shangsi Camp, and Zhen'an Brigade each camp's troops—some changed braves to supplement soldiers, some cut soldiers and retained braves—each according to what was fitting; that is, the measure of divided defense was a plan for merging and economizing.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Zhang Zhidong then reorganized the Xintai Brigade, Shangsi Camp, and Zhen'an Brigade along the border—replacing some braves with regulars or cutting regulars while retaining braves as suited each post—combining redistribution of garrisons with plans to economize.

sentences.zh: 十三年，復移駐鎮、道各員，以資分任。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, regional commanders and circuit intendants were again moved to garrison posts to supply divided responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, regional commanders and circuit intendants were again posted forward to share responsibility.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，譚鍾麟因邊境迤長凡千七百里，僅恃營汛，終嫌單薄，乃扼要建築砲台。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Tan Zhonglin, because the border extends long in all a thousand seven hundred li and relying only on camps and flood garrisons was ultimately thin, then at choke points built cannon platforms.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, Tan Zhonglin found the 1,700-li frontier too thinly held by camps and outposts alone and built fortifications at critical points.

sentences.zh: 原有防軍二十營，以分防見少，每營止能抽撥二棚駐守砲台。

translations.literal: The original twenty defense camps, because divided defense appeared few, each camp could only draw two sheds to garrison the cannon platforms.
translations.idiomatic: Of the existing twenty defense battalions, so many were spread along the line that each could spare only two squads to man the new forts.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，蘇元春因南、太、泗、鎮及上思、歸順四府二廳州，皆為邊地，勇丁數僅萬人，凡三關百隘，沿邊砲台，皆須防守。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Su Yuanchun, because Nan, Tai, Si, Zhen, and Shangsi and Guishun four prefectures and two departments and prefectures were all border lands, brave soldiers numbered only ten thousand—in all three passes and a hundred barriers, along-border cannon platforms all required defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, Su Yuanchun noted that Nanning, Taiping, Sishan, Zhen'an, Shangsi, and Guishun—all border prefectures and departments—had barely ten thousand braves to hold three major passes, a hundred barriers, and the coastal forts.

sentences.zh: 乃以新募調赴江南之五營，並抽調邊軍五營，合成十營，為剿辦沿邊游勇土匪之用。

translations.literal: Then five newly recruited camps shifted to Jiangnan, together with five border camps drawn out, were combined into ten camps for suppressing and handling along-border roaming braves and bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore combined five newly recruited battalions recalled from Jiangnan with five drawn from the border into ten battalions to suppress roaming braves and bandits along the frontier.

sentences.zh: 三十年，柯逢時令各州縣增募勇丁八千餘人，給以毛瑟後膛槍，以佐防軍，並令各屬勸民間多築碉堡，藉御外侮。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, Ke Fengshi ordered each prefecture and county to additionally recruit more than eight thousand braves, issued Mauser breech-loading rifles to assist the defense troops, and also ordered subordinates to encourage the populace to build many blockhouses, thereby to resist foreign aggression.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, Ke Fengshi had every prefecture and county raise over eight thousand braves, armed them with Mauser breech-loaders to support the frontier garrison, and urged local officials to promote civilian blockhouses as a buffer against foreign encroachment.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，李經羲以廣西沿邊，全恃防軍，近年邊防大軍，專駐龍州訓練，而南、太、鎮等郡，以迄滇邊，無復邊營蹤跡，客軍又撤回過半，乃酌增防營，募土著親兵，就地防禦。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, Li Jingxi, because Guangxi along the border relied entirely on defense troops—in recent years the great frontier army was stationed solely at Longzhou for training—while Nan, Tai, Zhen and other prefectures through to the Yunnan border had no trace of border camps remaining, and guest troops had been withdrawn by more than half—accordingly increased defense battalions and recruited native personal troops for local defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, Li Jingxi observed that Guangxi’s frontier depended wholly on defense forces: the main border army now trained only at Longzhou, while Nanning, Taiping, Zhen’an, and the route to Yunnan no longer had border camps, and more than half the outside troops had been pulled back. He therefore added defense battalions and recruited local militia for on-the-spot defense.

sentences.zh: 蓋廣西制兵，舊額六萬二千餘人，自同治四年以後，屢加裁汰，由制兵而趨重防軍。

translations.literal: For Guangxi regular troops, the old quota was more than sixty-two thousand men; from the fourth year of Tongzhi onward they were repeatedly cut, shifting from regular troops toward emphasizing defense troops.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi’s standing army had once numbered over sixty-two thousand; after repeated reductions since Tongzhi 4, the province had shifted from regular Green Standard troops to frontier defense forces.

sentences.zh: 法、越事起，於邊地防軍，尤為注重。

translations.literal: When the Franco-Vietnamese affair arose, borderland defense troops were especially emphasized.
translations.idiomatic: The Sino-French and Vietnamese crises made frontier defense units a top priority.

sentences.zh: 至光緒季年，改練新軍，非復防營規制矣。

translations.literal: By the late Guangxu years, they were reorganized into the new army; it was no longer the defense-battalion system.
translations.idiomatic: In the closing years of Guangxu, training shifted to the new army, and the old defense-battalion framework was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 蒙古以瀚海為界畫，其部落之大類有四：曰漠南內蒙古，曰漠北外蒙古，曰漠西厄魯特蒙古，曰青海蒙古。

translations.literal: Mongolia takes the Gobi as its boundary line; its tribes fall into four great categories: Inner Mongolia south of the desert, Outer Mongolia north of the desert, Oirat Mongolia west of the desert, and Qinghai Mongolia.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol lands were demarcated by the Gobi into four major divisions: Inner Mongolia in the south, Outer Mongolia in the north, Oirat Mongolia in the west, and the Mongols of Qinghai.

sentences.zh: 清初，漠南蒙古臣服最先。

translations.literal: In the early Qing, Inner Mongolia south of the desert submitted first.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Mongolia was the first region to submit to the Qing at the dynasty’s founding.

sentences.zh: 至康熙初年，而漠北喀爾喀三部內款。

translations.literal: By the early Kangxi reign, the three Khalkha divisions of Outer Mongolia tendered allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Kangxi era the three Khalkha khanships of Outer Mongolia came in allegiance.

sentences.zh: 及親征準噶爾，而青海諸部來庭。

translations.literal: When the emperor campaigned in person against the Dzungars, the tribes of Qinghai came to court.
translations.idiomatic: After the emperor’s personal campaigns against the Dzungars, the Qinghai tribes presented themselves at court.

sentences.zh: 惟漠西厄魯特部，至乾隆間始征定焉。

translations.literal: Only the Oirat tribes west of the desert were not pacified by conquest until the Qianlong reign.
translations.idiomatic: The Oirat west of the Gobi were not finally subdued until the Qianlong period.

sentences.zh: 漠北外四盟蒙古，康熙間初定，增為五十五旗。

translations.literal: The four-league Outer Mongol tribes north of the desert were first fixed in the Kangxi reign and increased to fifty-five banners.
translations.idiomatic: Outer Mongolia’s original four leagues were organized under Kangxi into fifty-five banners.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，增三音諾顏部，共前三部為四部。

translations.literal: In the Yongzheng reign the Sain Noyan division was added, making four divisions together with the former three.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzheng added the Sain Noyan league, bringing the former three divisions to four.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，增至八十二旗。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong period they were increased to eighty-two banners.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong the banners grew to eighty-two.

sentences.zh: 其會盟分四路：土謝圖汗為中路，車臣汗為東路，札薩克圖汗為西路，三音諾顏為北路。

translations.literal: Their league assemblies were divided into four routes: the Tüsheet Khan as the central route, the Sechen Khan as the eastern route, the Zasagtu Khan as the western route, and Sain Noyan as the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: League councils met along four circuits: Tüsheet Khan in the center, Sechen Khan in the east, Zasagtu Khan in the west, and Sain Noyan in the north.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，築城於烏里雅蘇台及科布多二處以鎮撫之。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong reign, cities were built at Uliastai and Kobdo in two places to pacify and comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong built garrison towns at Uliastai and Kobdo to keep the region under control.

sentences.zh: 其統率蒙兵之制，內札薩克之兵，統於盟長。

translations.literal: As for the system commanding Mongol troops, inner zasak troops were commanded by league chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Mongol forces were organized so that inner zasak banners answered to their league chiefs.

sentences.zh: 外札薩克之兵，統於定邊左副將軍。

translations.literal: Outer zasak troops were commanded by the Left Deputy General for Frontier Pacification.
translations.idiomatic: Outer zasak troops fell under the Left Deputy General for Frontier Pacification.

sentences.zh: 杜爾伯特及新土耳扈特、和碩特之兵，統於科布多辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Troops of the Dorbet and the new Torghut and Khoshut were commanded by the Kobdo administrative commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Dorbet, new Torghut, and Khoshut soldiers were placed under the Kobdo commissioner.

sentences.zh: 土耳扈特之兵統於伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: Torghut troops were commanded by the Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: Torghut forces reported to the Ili general.

sentences.zh: 青海各部落之兵，統於西寧辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Troops of the various tribes of Qinghai were commanded by the Xining administrative commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Qinghai tribal forces were directed by the Xining commissioner.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，西陲未靖，阿爾泰及河套以北，迤西直達巴里坤，平原沙磧，數千里間，無險可扼。

translations.literal: In the Yongzheng reign the western frontier was not yet settled; from the Altai and north of the Ordos, extending west straight to Barkol, plains and sandy wastes for several thousand li had no terrain that could be held.
translations.idiomatic: During Yongzheng the west was still unsettled: from the Altai and Ordos northward west to Barkol stretched thousands of li of open steppe and desert with no natural choke points.

sentences.zh: 乃於四台至三十五台，每台選精兵駐守，互為聲援。

translations.literal: Thereupon from the fourth station to the thirty-fifth station, at each station elite troops were selected to garrison, mutually supporting one another.
translations.idiomatic: From the fourth to the thirty-fifth courier station, each post was manned with picked troops who could reinforce one another.

sentences.zh: 於烏里雅蘇台城外山顛扼要處，復各建砲台，屯重兵於特斯台錫里。

translations.literal: Outside Uliastai city at commanding points on the mountain crests, cannon platforms were again built at each place, and heavy troops were stationed at Testsentseer.
translations.idiomatic: Key heights outside Uliastai received new batteries, and a strong detachment was posted at Testsentseer.

sentences.zh: 旋增設卡路八處於鹽口、戈壁二口，遣兵更番巡探，以期嚴密。

translations.literal: Soon eight additional karun posts were set up at Yankou and Gobi passes, troops sent in rotation to patrol, in hope of strictness.
translations.idiomatic: Eight new karun checkpoints were added at the Salt Pass and Gobi Pass, with rotating patrols to tighten control.

sentences.zh: 其時防在西徼，而北鄙無驚。

translations.literal: At that time defense lay on the western marches, while the northern frontier had no alarm.
translations.idiomatic: Attention then focused on the western border, while the northern frontier remained quiet.

sentences.zh: 自乾隆間蕩平准部，而衛拉特來歸，內外各盟長，從征回、准，屢奏邊勛，新舊土耳扈特，同膺茅土，北境俄羅斯亦方輯睦，陰山、瀚海間，百有餘年無事矣。

translations.literal: From the Qianlong reign, when the Dzungar department was swept pacified, the Oirat came to allegiance; inner and outer league chiefs followed campaigns in the Muslim regions and Dzungaria and repeatedly reported frontier merit; old and new Torghut alike received enfeoffments; Russia on the northern border was also then on friendly terms—in the region between the Yin Mountains and the Gobi, for more than a hundred years there was no trouble.
translations.idiomatic: After Qianlong crushed the Dzungars, the Oirat submitted and league chiefs from both Inner and Outer Mongolia earned honors campaigning in Xinjiang; old and new Torghut alike received fiefs; Russia too was conciliatory along the north. For over a century between the Yinshan and the Gobi the frontier knew peace.

sentences.zh: 迨咸豐、同治間，中原多故，蒙邊亦多不靖。

translations.literal: By the Xianfeng and Tongzhi period, the central plains had many troubles and the Mongol borderlands also grew unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: During Xianfeng and Tongzhi turmoil at the center spread to the Mongol frontiers as well.

sentences.zh: 同治四年，增熱河馬隊三百人。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tongzhi, three hundred Rehe cavalry were added.
translations.idiomatic: Tongzhi 4 added three hundred Rehe mounted troops.

sentences.zh: 五年，以包頭鎮為綏遠要區，原有防兵，積年疲乏，調吉林馬隊協同駐守。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, because Baotou town was a vital area of Suiyuan, the original defense troops, worn down over years, had Jilin cavalry detachments transferred to garrison jointly.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 5, Baotou—critical to Suiyuan—had its exhausted garrison reinforced with Jilin cavalry.

sentences.zh: 六年，李雲麟以三音諾顏蒙兵專防烏城，而招募奇古民勇駐八里岡，與科布多、塔爾巴哈台二城蒙兵為犄角。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Li Yunlin used Sain Noyan Mongol troops solely to defend Urga city, while recruiting Qigu braves to garrison Baligang, forming a pincer with Mongol troops of Kobdo and Tarbagatai.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 6, Li Yunlin stationed Sain Noyan Mongols at Urga, recruited Qigu militia at Baligang, and coordinated them with Mongol garrisons at Kobdo and Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 八年，以布倫託海各領隊大臣所有旗兵，改隸科布多大臣，分防熱河等處。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the banner troops belonging to each brigade commander at Buluntu Hai were transferred to the Kobdo commissioner and distributed to defend Rehe and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 8, Buluntu Hai brigade banner forces were reassigned to the Kobdo commissioner for duty in Rehe and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 令烏梁海總管，自卜果蘇克霸至沙賓達巴哈與俄羅斯接界處，新立鄂博界牌八處，嚴密巡察。

translations.literal: The Uriankhai superintendent was ordered, from Bogusukba to the Russian border at Shabindabaha, to erect eight new oboo boundary markers and patrol them strictly.
translations.idiomatic: Uriankhai officials were told to erect eight new oboo markers from Bogusukba to Shabindabaha on the Russian line and patrol them closely.

sentences.zh: 徙厄魯特僧眾於阿爾泰山，徙俗眾於青格里河。

translations.literal: Oirat clergy were moved to the Altai Mountains, and lay populations to the Qinggeli River.
translations.idiomatic: Oirat monks were relocated to the Altai; lay communities to the Qinggeli River.

sentences.zh: 九年，調大同、宣化練軍二千人駐防庫倫，修復推河以北至烏城十五台站，並牧馬三千匹，熱河增練洋槍隊三百人，以固庫倫西路之防。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, two thousand Datong and Xuanhua drilled troops were transferred to garrison Urga; fifteen courier stations north of the Tui River through to Urga were restored; three thousand horses were pastured; Rehe added three hundred drilled foreign-rifle troops to solidify defense on Urga’s western route.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 9, two thousand drilled troops from Datong and Xuanhua garrisoned Urga; fifteen stations north of the Tui River to Urga were repaired; three thousand remounts were kept; and Rehe added three hundred riflemen to secure the western approach to Urga.

sentences.zh: 十年，以濟斯洪果爾台站為察哈爾及歸化、綏遠運糧要區，撥兵駐守。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, because the Jis Hongguo’er station was a vital grain-transport area for Chahar and Guihua and Suiyuan, troops were allocated to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 10, Jis Hongguo’er station—a key grain corridor for Chahar, Guihua, and Suiyuan—received a garrison detachment.

sentences.zh: 令蒙古各台，自張家口至八台，以察哈爾都統管理。

translations.literal: Mongol stations from Zhangjiakou to the eighth station were placed under the Chahar commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Courier posts from Zhangjiakou to the eighth station were placed under the Chahar commander.

sentences.zh: 自九台至科布多，及庫倫、歸化二路，以各盟長管理。

translations.literal: From the ninth station to Kobdo, and the Urga and Guihua routes, were managed by the various league chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Stations from the ninth post to Kobdo, and the Urga and Guihua lines, were managed by league chiefs.

sentences.zh: 每台增設駝馬百五十匹，凡軍械糧食，接護轉運，以利軍行。

translations.literal: At each station one hundred fifty camels and horses were added; all arms and grain were escorted and transferred to benefit military movement.
translations.idiomatic: Each station gained 150 pack animals so arms and provisions could be relayed without delay.

sentences.zh: 十一年，改建烏里雅蘇台石城，並整頓沿邊台務。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the stone city at Uliastai was rebuilt and along-border station affairs were put in order.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 11, Uliastai’s stone fort was rebuilt and frontier courier posts were reorganized.

sentences.zh: 庫倫西接俄疆，向未設兵，乃於圖、車兩盟蒙兵內，輪派四百人，分駐庫倫四境。

translations.literal: Urga on the west adjoined Russian territory and had never had troops stationed; thereupon four hundred men were rotated from Mongol troops of the Tüsheet and Sechen leagues and distributed to garrison the four quarters of Urga.
translations.idiomatic: Urga bordered Russia to the west but had long lacked a garrison; four hundred Mongol troops from the Tüsheet and Sechen leagues were then rotated in to hold the four approaches.

sentences.zh: 十二年，調察哈爾馬隊協防烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Chahar cavalry were transferred to assist in defending Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 12, Chahar horse detachments reinforced Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 旋以軍台四十四站，地勢綿長，分防散漫。

translations.literal: Soon because the forty-four military courier stations stretched over a long terrain, distributed defense was scattered.
translations.idiomatic: The forty-four military stations along the route proved too long and thinly manned.

sentences.zh: 乃分為四路，於中二路擇要駐營，調綏遠城馬隊移防哈爾尼敦，以原有之兵守塞爾烏蘇。

translations.literal: Thereupon they were divided into four routes; on the two central routes key points were chosen for camp garrisons; Suiyuan city cavalry were shifted to defend Kharniidun, while the original troops held Sir Öös.
translations.idiomatic: The line was split into four sectors; the two middle routes received concentrated camps; Suiyuan cavalry moved to Kharniidun while existing troops held Sir Öös.

sentences.zh: 至光緒間，新疆大定，西顧無虞，而北境俄患漸偪。

translations.literal: By the Guangxu period Xinjiang was greatly settled, the western rear had no worry, but Russian trouble on the northern border gradually pressed close.
translations.idiomatic: Under Guangxu, once Xinjiang was pacified the west was secure, yet Russian pressure on the northern frontier steadily increased.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年，調宣化練軍、直隸步隊赴庫倫防俄。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu, Xuanhua drilled troops and Zhili infantry were transferred to Urga to guard against Russia.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxu 6 sent Xuanhua drilled troops and Zhili infantry to Urga against Russian encroachment.

sentences.zh: 七年，因烏城三面鄰俄，邊防重要，而原有防軍，技藝生疏，烏城共駐蒙古練軍及黑龍江、察哈爾馬隊二千五百人，由京營派教習前往教練，俾成勁旅。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, because Urga city on three sides neighbored Russia and frontier defense was important, while the original defense troops’ skills were crude—in all at Urga two thousand five hundred Mongol drilled troops and Heilongjiang and Chahar cavalry were stationed—instructors were dispatched from the capital garrisons to drill them, so that they might become a strong force.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxu 7: Urga faced Russia on three sides, yet its garrison was poorly trained. Two thousand five hundred Mongol drilled troops plus Heilongjiang and Chahar cavalry were posted there, with instructors from Beijing to turn them into an effective force.

sentences.zh: 十八年，李鴻章以熱河東境山谷叢雜，毗連奉天，撥直隸練軍馬步隊各一營擇要駐防。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, Li Hongzhang, because Rehe’s eastern territory had tangled valleys and adjoined Fengtian, allocated one battalion each of Zhili drilled cavalry and infantry to garrison at key points.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 18, Li Hongzhang posted one battalion each of Zhili drilled horse and foot at strategic points in eastern Rehe, where rugged terrain met Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，以熱河、察哈爾為蒙邊要地，令各都統等選練兵丁，整備軍實。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, because Rehe and Chahar were vital Mongol borderlands, each commander-in-chief and the like was ordered to select and drill troops and ready military stores.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxu 24 ordered commanders in Rehe and Chahar to drill troops and stock supplies across the Mongol frontier.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，以熱河馬步隊三營改編為常備軍，其兵額均次第補足。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, three Rehe horse-and-foot battalions were reorganized as standing army; their quotas were all filled in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxu 32 converted three Rehe mixed battalions into the standing army and brought their rolls up to strength.

sentences.zh: 時內外蒙古兵日益孱弱，俄人遂駸駸闌入，烏梁海以南受其牢籠，喀魯倫河以東恣其墾牧，鄂博、卡倫遂同虛設矣。

translations.literal: At that time Inner and Outer Mongol troops daily grew weak; Russians then gradually intruded step by step; south of Uriankhai they fell under Russian control; east of the Kerulen River they freely opened land and grazed herds; oboo markers and karun posts thus became the same as empty establishments.
translations.idiomatic: By then Mongol forces had grown feeble; Russia advanced steadily—controlling Uriankhai lands to the south, farming and grazing east of the Kerulen, while boundary oboos and karun posts became mere formalities.

sentences.zh: 直隸沿蒙邊防務，雍正九年，令直隸疆臣修治邊牆，其古北、宣化、大同三處，咸募兵增防。

translations.literal: Zhili frontier defense along the Mongol border: in the ninth year of Yongzheng, Zhili frontier officials were ordered to repair the border wall; at Gubeikou, Xuanhua, and Datong three places, all recruited troops to increase defense.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili’s Mongol frontier: in Yongzheng 9 the province was told to repair the border wall and recruit reinforcements at Gubeikou, Xuanhua, and Datong.

sentences.zh: 自獨石口以西，至殺虎口一帶要隘，亦酌增弁兵。

translations.literal: From Dushikou westward to the vital passes along the Shahekou stretch, officers and troops were also suitably increased.
translations.idiomatic: Key passes from Dushikou west to Shahekou likewise received additional officers and men.

sentences.zh: 十年，於獨石口改設副將以下各官，增額兵八百人，邊牆衝要處，增設鹿柵木柵，以備堵御。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, at Dushikou deputy generals and subordinate officials were re-established, quota troops increased by eight hundred; at vital points on the border wall, deer-palisade and wooden palisades were added to prepare for blocking defense.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzheng 10 reinstated command posts at Dushikou, added 800 quota troops, and erected deer-fence and timber palisades at critical points on the wall.

sentences.zh: 自清初至乾隆、嘉慶朝，蒙邊綏輯。

translations.literal: From the early Qing through the Qianlong and Jiaqing reigns, the Mongol borderlands were pacified and settled.
translations.idiomatic: From the founding Qing through Qianlong and Jiaqing, the Mongol frontier remained tranquil.

sentences.zh: 咸、同之間，西陲用兵，蒙匪亦漸滋事。

translations.literal: Between Xianfeng and Tongzhi, with warfare on the western marches, Mongol bandits also gradually caused trouble.
translations.idiomatic: During Xianfeng and Tongzhi, western campaigns coincided with rising Mongol unrest.

sentences.zh: 同治四年，以直隸北境沿邊關口五十餘處，兵數甚單，調撥京師火器營、威遠隊、提標馬步隊，分駐喜峰口、鐵門關、灤陽、灑河橋、遵化、羅文峪迤北迤西等處。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tongzhi, because along Zhili’s northern border there were more than fifty passes and troop numbers were very thin, the capital Firearms Camp, Weiyuan Detachment, and provincial-command horse and foot were transferred and distributed to garrison Xifengkou, Tiemenguan, Luanyang, Sahaoqiao, Zunhua, Luowenyu, and places north and west thereof.
translations.idiomatic: Tongzhi 4: over fifty Zhili northern passes were badly undermanned, so Beijing’s Firearms Camp, Weiyuan Detachment, and provincial troops were posted to Xifengkou, Tiemenguan, Luanyang, Sahaoqiao, Zunhua, Luowenyu, and points north and west.

sentences.zh: 光緒七年，李鴻章以北邊多倫廳地兼蒙旗，僅有新舊防軍七百餘人，不敷分佈，增調宣化練軍馬隊一營分段梭巡。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Guangxu, Li Hongzhang, because the northern border’s Duolun subprefecture lands mixed Mongol banners and had only more than seven hundred old and new defense troops, insufficient for distribution, additionally transferred one Xuanhua drilled cavalry battalion for segmented rotating patrol.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxu 7: Li Hongzhang noted Duolun’s mixed Mongol banners had barely 700 defense troops—too few to cover the ground—and added an Xuanhua cavalry battalion for rotating patrols.

sentences.zh: 十八年，以直隸防軍五營駐古北口。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, five Zhili defense battalions were stationed at Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxu 18 placed five Zhili defense battalions at Gubeikou.

sentences.zh: 十九年，李鴻章因古北口防營調回內地，而熱河地廣兵單，乃別練馬隊三哨，與原有之朝陽馬隊一營、圍場馬隊百人，互為援應。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, Li Hongzhang, because Gubeikou defense camps were transferred back to the interior while Rehe was broad in territory and thin in troops, separately drilled three cavalry platoons, which with the original Chaoyang cavalry battalion and one hundred Yuan hunting-ground cavalry mutually supported one another.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxu 19: with Gubeikou troops recalled inland and Rehe vast but weakly garrisoned, Li Hongzhang raised three new cavalry platoons to support the existing Chaoyang battalion and hundred-man hunting-ground detachment.

sentences.zh: 直隸邊務，重在海疆，東之山海關，為遼、瀋門戶，南之天津、大沽，為京師屏蔽。

translations.literal: Zhili border affairs emphasized the maritime frontier: in the east Shanhaiguan was the gateway to Liaoning and Shenyang; in the south Tianjin and Dagu were the screen for the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili’s strategic weight lay on the coast: Shanhaiguan guarded the Liaodong approach, while Tianjin and Dagu shielded Beijing.

sentences.zh: 其北境惟緝捕蒙匪，無事重兵屯戍也。

translations.literal: Its northern territory only required pursuing and capturing Mongol bandits; there was no need to station heavy troops.
translations.idiomatic: The northern marches needed only patrols against Mongol raiders, not large permanent garrisons.

sentences.zh: 山西邊界之歸化、綏遠、包頭鎮，控扼草地，毗連大青山，南抵殺虎口，西逾纏金，東接得勝口，與蒙古、回部錯壤。

translations.literal: Shanxi’s border places Guihua, Suiyuan, and Baotou town controlled the pasturelands, adjoined the Daqing Mountains, reached south to Shahekou, crossed west beyond Chanjin, joined east at Deshengkou, and interlocked with Mongol and Muslim territories.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi’s frontier zone—Guihua, Suiyuan, and Baotou—commanded the grasslands below the Daqing Mountains, from Shahekou south to Chanjin west and Deshengkou east, where Mongol and Muslim lands met.

sentences.zh: 咸豐軍興以後，官兵四齣征討，邊備空虛，寇盜乘機竊發。

translations.literal: After military troubles arose in the Xianfeng reign, officers and troops went out in four directions on campaigns, border preparations were empty, and bandits seized the opportunity to rise secretly.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Xianfeng wars began, Shanxi troops were scattered on campaigns, the border was stripped bare, and bandits took advantage.

sentences.zh: 同治六年，左宗棠督師秦、晉，以山西省弁兵團勇均不可恃，乃分撥營勇，駐守黃河西南兩岸，別募三千人，赴禹門、保德間防守，並造砲船四十艘，酌配水師，駐垣曲、三門一帶。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tongzhi, Zuo Zongtang commanded armies in Shaanxi and Shanxi; because Shanxi’s officers, troops, and militia were all unreliable, he distributed camp braves to garrison both banks southwest of the Yellow River, separately recruited three thousand men to defend between Yumen and Baode, and built forty gunboats, suitably assigning naval troops to garrison the Yuncheng and Sanmen stretch.
translations.idiomatic: Tongzhi 6: finding Shanxi’s regulars and militia untrustworthy, Zuo Zongtang posted troops along the Yellow River’s southwest banks, raised 3,000 men for the Yumen–Baode sector, and built forty gunboats with sailors at Yuncheng and Sanmen.

sentences.zh: 軍事定後，防軍旋撤。

translations.literal: After military affairs were settled, defense troops were soon withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: When fighting ended, the frontier garrison was quickly withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 光緒間，曾國荃調撥湘軍，擇要屯守，而兵數僅一千二百人。

translations.literal: In the Guangxu period, Zeng Guoquan transferred Hunan Army troops to garrison at key points, but troop numbers were only one thousand two hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Under Guangxu, Zeng Guoquan sent Hunan Army detachments to key posts—but only 1,200 men.

sentences.zh: 九年，張之洞以雁門關為晉邊要口，止有練軍千人，令各營以次抽練，以固邊防。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Zhang Zhidong, because Yanmen Pass was a vital mouth of the Shanxi border and had only one thousand drilled troops, ordered each camp to drill in rotation to solidify frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxu 9: Zhang Zhidong ordered rotational drilling at every camp because Yanmen Pass, Shanxi’s main gateway, had only 1,000 trained troops.

sentences.zh: 十年，增練大同、太原二鎮馬步營。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, drilled horse and foot battalions of the Datong and Taiyuan garrisons were increased.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxu 10 expanded drilled cavalry and infantry at the Datong and Taiyuan commands.

sentences.zh: 衛榮光增練馬隊五旗，以三旗駐口外，二旗駐口內，以佐湘軍之不逮。

translations.literal: Wei Rongguang increased drilled cavalry by five banners, three banners garrisoned outside the pass and two inside, to assist where the Hunan Army fell short.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Rongguang added five cavalry banners—three beyond the pass, two within—to supplement the Hunan Army’s gaps.

sentences.zh: 由山西省迤西，為陝西之北境，惟榆林、神木一隅，地接蒙疆，而障以長城，環以河套，民情馴朴，防務更簡於燕、晉也。

translations.literal: Westward from Shanxi Province is Shaanxi’s northern territory; only the corner of Yulin and Shenmu adjoined the Mongol frontier, yet was screened by the Great Wall and encircled by the Ordos bend—the people’s customs were docile and simple, and frontier affairs were even simpler than in Yan and Jin.
translations.idiomatic: West of Shanxi lies northern Shaanxi: only Yulin and Shenmu touched the Mongol border, but the Great Wall and Ordos loop sheltered them; the population was tractable and defenses lighter than in Hebei or Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 新疆為西域三十六國故壤，歷代籌邊列戍，近在玉門，遠亦僅龍堆而外。

translations.literal: Xinjiang was the former territory of the thirty-six kingdoms of the Western Regions; dynasties through the ages planned border defense and arrayed garrisons—near at the Jade Gate, far also only beyond the Dragon Mounds.
translations.idiomatic: Xinjiang occupied the old lands of the Western Regions’ thirty-six states; for centuries China had posted garrisons from the Jade Gate to little beyond the Dragon Mounds.

sentences.zh: 自乾隆年准部平，道光朝回疆定，至光緒間，再定天山，開省治於迪化城，設五府三十六縣。

translations.literal: From the Qianlong year when the Dzungar department was pacified, the Daoguang reign when the Muslim borderlands were settled, to the Guangxu period when the Tianshan was again pacified, provincial administration was opened at Dihua city, establishing five prefectures and thirty-six counties.
translations.idiomatic: After Qianlong crushed the Dzungars and Daoguang secured the Muslim south, Guangxu reconquered the Tianshan, made Dihua the provincial capital, and organized five prefectures and thirty-six counties.

sentences.zh: 而俄羅斯邊境由北而西，綿延錯亙。

translations.literal: Yet the Russian border from north to west extended in long interlocking stretches.
translations.idiomatic: Russia’s frontier meanwhile stretched along Xinjiang from north to west in an unbroken chain.

sentences.zh: 自奪取霍罕三部後，伊犁及南路喀什噶爾皆與俄屬相接。

translations.literal: After seizing the three Kokand khanates, Ili and the southern route at Kashgar both adjoined Russian territory.
translations.idiomatic: Once Russia absorbed the three Kokand khanates, Ili and southern Kashgaria shared a border with Russian holdings.

sentences.zh: 全境中界天山，分南北二路。

translations.literal: The whole territory was divided by the Tianshan in the center into northern and southern routes.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianshan divided the province into a northern and a southern circuit.

sentences.zh: 北路為準噶爾部落，西北以伊犁為重鎮，烏魯木齊當往來孔道，塔爾巴哈台為北境屏籓。

translations.literal: The northern route was the Dzungar tribal lands; in the northwest Ili was the vital stronghold, Ürümqi lay on the thoroughfare of traffic, and Tarbagatai was the northern screen.
translations.idiomatic: The north belonged to the Dzungars: Ili was the northwestern stronghold, Ürümqi the main corridor, and Tarbagatai the northern shield.

sentences.zh: 南路悉回族所居，烏什當適中之地。

translations.literal: The southern route was entirely where Hui people dwelt; Wushi occupied the central place.
translations.idiomatic: The south was Hui territory, with Wushi at its center.

sentences.zh: 葉爾羌、喀什噶爾雄冠諸城。

translations.literal: Yarkand and Kashgar towered above the other cities.
translations.idiomatic: Yarkand and Kashgar were the foremost cities.

sentences.zh: 英吉薩爾西達外籓。

translations.literal: Yingjisha’er reached west to the outer vassals.
translations.idiomatic: Yingjisha’er extended westward toward the outer dependencies.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十八年，以準噶爾逼處邊境，哈密及西藏北路雖已設防，而選將備，具駝馬，簡軍實，勘水草，儲糧餉，修城垣，諸端待理。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Qianlong, because the Dzungars pressed on the border, although Hami and the northern route of Tibet had already been provided defense, selecting generals, preparing [supplies], providing camels and horses, simplifying military stores, surveying water and grass, storing grain pay, repairing city walls—all ends awaited handling.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 18: with Dzungars on the border, Hami and Tibet’s northern route already had garrisons, yet choosing commanders, stockpiling camels, horses, arms, fodder, grain, and repairing fortifications all remained to be done.

sentences.zh: 命疆吏先事籌備，次第施行。

translations.literal: Frontier officials were ordered to prepare matters beforehand and implement them in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Border officials were told to prepare everything in advance and proceed step by step.

sentences.zh: 哈密已駐重兵，而防所全恃卡倫。

translations.literal: Hami already had heavy troops stationed, yet defense relied entirely on karun posts.
translations.idiomatic: Though Hami held a large garrison, its defense depended wholly on karun outposts.

sentences.zh: 天山冰雪嚴寒，加意撫循士卒。

translations.literal: The Tianshan’s ice and snow were severely cold; soldiers were especially comforted and cared for.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tianshan’s bitter cold, troops received extra care.

sentences.zh: 南路各城，以滿洲營、綠旗營協同防守。

translations.literal: Southern-route cities were jointly defended by Manchu garrisons and Green Standard garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Southern cities were held by both Manchu and Green Standard camps.

sentences.zh: 和闐、庫車、辟展諸城，則但設綠旗營兵。

translations.literal: Khotan, Kucha, Pizhan and other cities then only had Green Standard garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: Khotan, Kucha, Pizhan, and similar towns relied on Green Standard troops alone.

sentences.zh: 其卡倫台站，自哈密西至辟展，北至巴里坤，自辟展西至庫車，北至烏魯木齊，自庫車西至烏什，又西至葉爾羌，又西至喀什噶爾，其南至和闐，視卡倫之大小，定戍兵之多寡。

translations.literal: Their karun stations: from Hami west to Pizhan, north to Barkol; from Pizhan west to Kucha, north to Ürümqi; from Kucha west to Wushi, again west to Yarkand, again west to Kashgar, and south to Khotan—according to the size of the karun, the number of garrison troops was fixed more or less.
translations.idiomatic: Karun and courier posts ran from Hami west to Pizhan and north to Barkol; from Pizhan west to Kucha and north to Ürümqi; from Kucha through Wushi and Yarkand to Kashgar, and south to Khotan—garrison strength scaled with each post’s importance.

sentences.zh: 各台站設駝馬車輛毋缺，前行阻水，則造舟以濟之。

translations.literal: Each station was provided camels, horses, and vehicles without shortage; where advance was blocked by water, boats were built to cross.
translations.idiomatic: Every station kept full camel, horse, and cart transport; where rivers blocked the route, boats were built to ferry troops.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，戡定準部，北路重地，咸分兵設防，山川隘口，悉置卡倫台站。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, when the Dzungar department was pacified by force, vital places on the northern route all had troops distributed for defense; mountain passes and defiles all had karun stations set.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 24, after the Dzungars were crushed, key northern positions were garrisoned and every pass received karun posts.

sentences.zh: 各卡倫設索倫、錫伯、厄魯特兵丁自十名至三十餘名有差。

translations.literal: Each karun had Solon, Xibe, and Oirat soldiers from ten to more than thirty men, with differences.
translations.idiomatic: Each karun held ten to thirty-plus Solon, Xibe, or Oirat soldiers depending on need.

sentences.zh: 各台站設滿洲、綠旗、察哈爾兵丁各十五名。

translations.literal: Each station had fifteen Manchu, Green Standard, and Chahar soldiers each.
translations.idiomatic: Each courier station had fifteen Manchu, fifteen Green Standard, and fifteen Chahar troops.

sentences.zh: 南路各城設辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Southern-route cities had administrative commissioners established.
translations.idiomatic: Every major southern city received an administrative commissioner.

sentences.zh: 其理事回官阿奇木伯克以下，各有所司，分統回兵，隸駐防大臣調遣。

translations.literal: Their Hui officials for managing affairs, from the aqim beg downward, each had his charge, divided command of Hui troops, and were subordinate to the garrison commissioner’s dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: Hui officials from the aqim beg down each managed affairs, commanded local Hui troops, and answered to the garrison commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，設伊犁馬步兵二千五百人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Ili horse and foot infantry of two thousand five hundred were established.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 26 established 2,500 Ili cavalry and infantry.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，設伊犁將軍及參贊領隊大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, the Ili general and participating brigade commanders were established.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 27 created the Ili generalship and brigade commanders.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，設烏魯木齊辦事大臣。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, the Ürümqi administrative commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 31 added the Ürümqi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，於惠遠城之北關，增調戍兵。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing, at the north pass of Huiyuan city, garrison troops were additionally transferred.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaqing 2 reinforced the north gate garrison outside Huiyuan.

sentences.zh: 道光六年，以新疆防軍已增至萬餘人，令疆吏調兵四千人赴回疆，二千人赴阿克蘇，協力防堵。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Daoguang, because Xinjiang defense troops had already increased to more than ten thousand, frontier officials were ordered to transfer four thousand troops to the Muslim borderlands and two thousand to Aksu, jointly blocking defense.
translations.idiomatic: Daoguang 6: with Xinjiang’s garrison above 10,000, officials sent 4,000 men to the Muslim frontier and 2,000 to Aksu.

sentences.zh: 又因喀什噶爾防兵較少，於城北要隘增兵三營，城南增兵二營。

translations.literal: Also because Kashgar’s defense troops were comparatively few, at vital passes north of the city three battalions were added and south of the city two battalions.
translations.idiomatic: Kashgar’s thin garrison gained three battalions at the northern passes and two south of the city.

sentences.zh: 八年，分遣喀什噶爾防兵四千三百人防守各路，選精壯二千人分十班教練。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Kashgar defense troops of four thousand three hundred were distributed to defend the various routes; two thousand picked strong men were divided into ten shifts for drilling.
translations.idiomatic: Daoguang 8 deployed 4,300 Kashgar troops along all routes and drilled 2,000 picked men in ten rotating squads.

sentences.zh: 那彥成因阿克蘇為南路要地，增兵千人，合原有防兵凡二千餘人，以控制南北二路。

translations.literal: Nayancheng, because Aksu was a vital place on the southern route, added one thousand troops; together with the original defense troops it came to more than two thousand, to control the northern and southern routes.
translations.idiomatic: Nayancheng reinforced Aksu—a strategic southern hub—with 1,000 men, bringing its garrison above 2,000 to hold both the northern and southern circuits.

sentences.zh: 其冰嶺一路，北通伊犁西南卡倫，外通烏什之捷徑，一律封禁。

translations.literal: As for the Bingling route, north it connected to Ili's southwest karun posts and outward to the shortcut to Ush—all alike were closed and forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: The Bingling pass route, which linked Ili's southwestern karun posts in the north with the shortcut to Ush beyond, was entirely sealed off.

sentences.zh: 喀什噶爾、葉爾羌、英吉薩爾各卡倫，向僅駐兵十餘名，乃於各卡倫適中處，凡通霍罕、巴達克山、克什米爾外夷之路，增築土堡，以都司等官率兵駐守，兵數自數十人至二百人不等。

translations.literal: At the karun posts of Kashgar, Yarkand, and Yengisar, formerly only a dozen-odd soldiers were stationed; then at suitable middle points of each karun, wherever roads led to foreign states of Kokand, Badakhshan, and Kashmir, earthen forts were added, with captains and other officers leading troops to garrison, troop numbers ranging from several tens to two hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Kashgar, Yarkand, and Yengisar had long kept only a dozen men at each karun post; earthen forts were now built at central points on every route toward Kokand, Badakhshan, and Kashmir, garrisoned by captains and their men in forces of several dozen up to two hundred.

sentences.zh: 九年，於喀什噶爾邊界增卡倫八處。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, at the Kashgar border eight karun posts were added.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, eight new karun posts were established along the Kashgar frontier.

sentences.zh: 十一年，回疆大定，命參贊大臣駐葉爾羌，總理八城回務，節制巴里坤、伊犁兩路滿、漢兵一萬四千餘人，分防各路。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the Muslim frontier was greatly settled; a Grand Minister Resident was ordered to station at Yarkand, overall managing the Muslim affairs of the eight cities, controlling more than fourteen thousand Manchu and Han troops of the Barkul and Ili routes, distributed to defend the various routes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, with the Muslim frontier largely pacified, a Grand Minister Resident was posted at Yarkand to oversee the eight cities' Muslim affairs and command over 14,000 Manchu and Han troops from the Barkul and Ili circuits, deployed along all routes.

sentences.zh: 喀什噶爾之八卡倫，道通霍罕，築土堡三座，增建兵房。

translations.literal: Kashgar's eight karun posts, with roads connecting Kokand, built three earthen forts and added barracks.
translations.idiomatic: Along Kashgar's eight karun posts on the Kokand road, three earthen forts were built and new barracks added.

sentences.zh: 葉爾羌所屬卡倫，通克什米爾外夷要隘，英吉薩爾通布魯特要隘，各修土堡駐兵。

translations.literal: Yarkand's subordinate karun posts connected vital passes to Kashmir foreigners; Yengisar connected vital passes to the Buruts—each repaired earthen forts and stationed troops.
translations.idiomatic: At Yarkand's karun posts facing Kashmir and Yengisar's facing the Burut passes, earthen forts were repaired and troops posted at each.

sentences.zh: 於烏克蘇、烏什二處，各駐八旗兵一千三百人。

translations.literal: At Uqturpan and Ush two places, each stationed Eight Banner troops of one thousand three hundred.
translations.idiomatic: At Uqturpan and Ush, 1,300 Eight Banner troops were stationed at each post.

sentences.zh: 於喀什噶爾駐綠營兵三千人，為前鋒，兼守邊卡。

translations.literal: At Kashgar stationed Green Standard troops of three thousand, as vanguard, also guarding border karun posts.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand Green Standard troops were posted at Kashgar as the vanguard, also manning the border karun posts.

sentences.zh: 英吉薩爾駐馬隊五百人，綠營兵千人，為前後二城中權接應之師。

translations.literal: At Yengisar stationed cavalry of five hundred, Green Standard troops of one thousand, as an army for flexible support between the front and rear two cities.
translations.idiomatic: Yengisar held 500 cavalry and 1,000 Green Standard troops as a mobile reserve between the forward and rear cities.

sentences.zh: 巴爾楚克綠營兵三千人，築堡屯守。

translations.literal: At Maralbeshi Green Standard troops of three thousand, built forts and garrisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand Green Standard troops at Maralbeshi built forts and settled in garrison.

sentences.zh: 和闐增足防兵五百人。

translations.literal: At Khotan supplemented defense troops by five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Khotan's garrison was reinforced by 500 men.

sentences.zh: 所餘滿、漢兵六千餘人，悉數駐葉爾羌，隸參贊大臣統轄，遇警援剿。

translations.literal: The remaining Manchu and Han troops of more than six thousand, all stationed at Yarkand, subordinate to the Grand Minister Resident's command, on alarm to assist in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining 6,000-odd Manchu and Han troops were concentrated at Yarkand under the Resident's command as a relief force for emergencies.

sentences.zh: 其喀什噶爾、葉爾羌舊額回兵，仍挑補訓練，以替防兵。

translations.literal: The old-quota Muslim troops of Kashgar and Yarkand were still picked, supplemented, and trained to replace the defense troops.
translations.idiomatic: Existing Muslim levies from Kashgar and Yarkand were re-selected, trained, and used to relieve the regular garrison.

sentences.zh: 十四年，以索倫、錫伯、察哈爾、額魯特四處營兵，守衛伊犁沿邊大小卡倫七十餘座，按期會哨，統兵將領，不得輕出邀功。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, using camp troops of Solon, Xibe, Chahar, and Oirat from four places, they guarded more than seventy large and small karun posts along Ili's border, joint patrols on schedule; commanding generals might not lightly go out seeking merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, Solon, Xibe, Chahar, and Oirat detachments manned over seventy karun posts along the Ili frontier on rotating patrols, while field commanders were forbidden to sally forth lightly in search of glory.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，廷臣會議，以新疆南北路駐兵益多，數逾三萬，頻年由內地換防，殊苦煩費，乃於伊犁等處綠營兵內調撥換班，其不足者，就地募之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng, court ministers in conference, because north and south route garrisons in Xinjiang grew ever more numerous, numbers exceeding thirty thousand, year after year relaying defenses from the interior was extremely burdensome in trouble and expense; then within Green Standard troops at Ili and other places shifts were transferred for rotation, and where insufficient, locally recruited.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 2, the court concluded that Xinjiang's north and south garrisons had swollen past 30,000 men and that rotating replacements from inland provinces was ruinously costly. Green Standard units at Ili and elsewhere were henceforth rotated internally, with local recruitment to fill any shortfall.

sentences.zh: 咸、同間，中原用兵，關外南北各城，邊氛四起。

translations.literal: Between Xianfeng and Tongzhi, the Central Plains used troops; beyond the passes north and south various cities saw border troubles rise everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianfeng and Tongzhi reigns, war in the heartland left cities across the northwest frontier beset by unrest on every side.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，調察哈爾蒙兵，悉數由科布多赴烏魯木齊屯守。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi, Chahar Mongol troops were transferred, all from Khobdo proceeding to Urumqi to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 2, Chahar Mongol detachments were moved from Khobdo to garrison Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 五年，調烏里雅蘇台蒙兵六千人赴伊犁。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Uliastai Mongol troops of six thousand were transferred to Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, 6,000 Mongol troops from Uliastai were sent to Ili.

sentences.zh: 九年，調黑龍江兵二千人，察哈爾兵千人，馬隊二百餘人，馳赴烏城，並令喀爾喀各盟長，隨時整頓蒙兵。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Heilongjiang troops of two thousand, Chahar troops of one thousand, and cavalry of more than two hundred were rushed to Wucheng; also the chiefs of each Khalkha league were ordered to rectify Mongol troops at all times.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, 2,000 Heilongjiang troops, 1,000 Chahar soldiers, and 200-odd cavalry were rushed to Urumqi, while Khalkha league chiefs were told to keep their Mongol forces in readiness.

sentences.zh: 十年，在烏梁海一帶，安設台站，迤西亦一律設台，直抵塔爾巴哈台。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, in the Uriankhai region relay stations were installed; westward also stations were uniformly set, straight reaching Tacheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, courier stations were established through Uriankhai country and continued westward all the way to Tacheng.

sentences.zh: 十一年，因庫爾喀喇烏蘇等處，為晶河要地，招募勇丁，協同馬隊防守。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, because Korgas and other places were vital ground on the Jing River, braves were recruited to defend jointly with the cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, militia were recruited to reinforce the cavalry at Korgas and other key points along the Jing River.

sentences.zh: 調宣化、古北口營兵，分赴烏城。

translations.literal: Troops of the Xuanhua and Gubeikou camps were transferred, divided to proceed to Wucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Units from the Xuanhua and Gubeikou garrisons were detached and sent to Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 十二年，調大同、宣化兵千人，赴防塔爾巴哈台。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Datong and Xuanhua troops of one thousand were transferred to defend Tacheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, 1,000 troops from Datong and Xuanhua were posted to Tacheng.

sentences.zh: 十三年，以塔城為西路防務扼要之區，調伊犁迤北之察哈爾兵二千人，及蒙古兵益之。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, because Tacheng was the chokepoint region of western-route defense, Chahar troops of two thousand from north of Ili were transferred, and Mongol troops were added.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Tacheng being the linchpin of the western defenses, 2,000 Chahar troops from north of Ili were shifted there and supplemented with Mongol forces.

sentences.zh: 尋命左宗棠由關、隴西征，天山內外，次第戡平，而俄羅斯亦歸我伊犁。

translations.literal: Soon Zuo Zongtang was ordered on a western campaign from the passes and Longxi; within and without the Tianshan, in turn all was pacified, and Russia also returned our Ili.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang was soon ordered west from Shaanxi and Gansu; the lands within and beyond the Tianshan were pacified in turn, and Russia restored Ili to Qing control.

sentences.zh: 光緒三年，左宗棠於伊犁增築砲台，多駐勁旅。

translations.literal: In the third year of Guangxu, Zuo Zongtang at Ili added built cannon forts and stationed many crack troops.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 3, Zuo Zongtang built new batteries at Ili and posted elite troops in strength.

sentences.zh: 劉錦棠就關外營勇之精壯者，編為制兵，改行餉為坐糧，參用屯田之法，以足軍實。

translations.literal: Liu Jintang from the picked strong among camp braves beyond the passes organized them as regular troops, changed traveling pay to sitting grain, and combined use of garrison-farming methods to fill army substance.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jintang enrolled the sturdiest frontier braves as regulars, converted campaign rations to standing grain allowances, and introduced garrison farming to sustain the army.

sentences.zh: 張曜更定新疆營制三事：一、增騎兵，佐步兵之不逮；

translations.literal: Zhang Yao revised Xinjiang's camp system in three matters: first, increase cavalry to assist where infantry falls short;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yao reorganized Xinjiang forces around three reforms: first, expand the cavalry to offset infantry weaknesses;

sentences.zh: 一、重火器，減養兵之費，為購器之資；

translations.literal: second, emphasize firearms, reduce the cost of maintaining idle troops, and use the savings to purchase weapons;
translations.idiomatic: second, stress firearms, cut idle-pay expenses, and divert the savings to arms procurement;

sentences.zh: 一、設游擊之師，駐南北路之間，預防俄患。

translations.literal: third, establish a mobile-strike force stationed between the north and south routes to guard against Russian trouble.
translations.idiomatic: third, field a mobile column between the northern and southern circuits as a hedge against Russian encroachment.

sentences.zh: 六年，恭鏜因烏魯木齊之鞏寧城，接壤精河，旁達烏城間道，而舊城已圮，乃於迪化城外高原，別建新城，以駐防兵，而資控扼。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Gong Jin because Urumqi's Gongning city bordered Jinghe and reached Wucheng by a side path, while the old city was already ruined, then on the high plateau outside Dihua city separately built a new city to garrison defense troops and provide control of the chokepoint.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, with Urumqi's Gongning city commanding Jinghe and the track to Urumqi while its old walls lay in ruins, Gong Jin built a new city on the heights outside Dihua to house the garrison and hold the crossroads.

sentences.zh: 十二年，劉錦棠以巴里坤滿營歸併古城，伊犁共駐馬步防軍二十八營，酌裁新募之勇，編留精壯，為馬隊九旗，步隊十三旗，自伊犁至大河沿及精河以東，分路駐防。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Liu Jintang merged the Barkul Manchu camp into Gucheng; at Ili together were stationed twenty-eight camps of cavalry-infantry defense troops,as appropriate cut newly recruited braves, organized and retained the strong as nine cavalry banners and thirteen infantry banners, from Ili to Daheyuan and east of Jinghe, divided routes for garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, Liu Jintang merged the Barkul Manchu garrison into Gucheng and concentrated twenty-eight cavalry and infantry camps at Ili; fresh levies were trimmed, the best men formed into nine cavalry and thirteen infantry banners, and posts were distributed from Ili through Daheyuan and east of Jinghe.

sentences.zh: 十四年，額爾慶額因塔爾巴哈台駐防漢隊，久役思歸，就甘肅額兵，及察哈爾部內，選二千六百人調防。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Erqing'e because the Han detachment garrisoning Tacheng, after long service, thought of returning, from Gansu quota troops and within the Chahar department selected two thousand six hundred for transferred defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, with Tacheng's long-serving Han garrison eager to rotate home, Erqing'e drew 2,600 replacements from Gansu's allotted troops and the Chahar banners.

sentences.zh: 十五年，復於塔城增募防兵，凡步隊三營，馬隊四旗，弁勇二千人。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, again at Tacheng increased recruited defense troops, in all three infantry battalions, four cavalry banners, officers and braves of two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, Tacheng recruited another 2,000 defenders in three infantry battalions and four cavalry banners.

sentences.zh: 十六年，以伊犁滿洲營，經兵亂後，額數久虛，酌量挑補，定為二千人，再挑留錫伯、新滿洲千人，以備不足。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, because the Ili Manchu camp after military disorder had long had empty quotas, as appropriate picked and supplemented, fixed at two thousand; again picked and retained Xibe and new Manchu of one thousand to prepare for insufficiency.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, the Ili Manchu garrison, depleted by war, was brought back to 2,000 men with selective recruitment, plus 1,000 Xibe and new Manchu reserves held in readiness.

sentences.zh: 伊犁漢隊改立標營，凡步隊一營，馬隊二營，格林砲隊一哨。

translations.literal: The Ili Han detachment was changed to establish a brigade camp, in all one infantry battalion, two cavalry battalions, and one Gordin gun post.
translations.idiomatic: Ili's Han force was reorganized as a brigade of one infantry battalion, two cavalry battalions, and a Gatling gun section.

sentences.zh: 惠遠城北關設砲隊一哨，定遠城設馬隊三旗。

translations.literal: North of Huiyuan city's gate one gun post was set; at Dingyuan city three cavalry banners were established.
translations.idiomatic: A gun section was posted at Huiyuan's north gate, and three cavalry banners at Dingyuan.

sentences.zh: 十七年，楊昌濬因塔城境內，漢、蒙、回、哈雜居，東接烏梁海，西接伊犁，地既險要，路復分歧，共增將弁三十一員，步隊三旗，馬隊四旗，以備巡防彈壓。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, Yang Changjun because within Tacheng territory Han, Mongol, Muslim, and Kazakh mixed dwelt, east connecting Uriankhai and west connecting Ili, the land being both dangerous and vital and roads again diverging, together increased thirty-one officers, three infantry banners, and four cavalry banners for patrol defense and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, Yang Changjun, noting Tacheng's mixed Han, Mongol, Muslim, and Kazakh population, its rugged terrain between Uriankhai and Ili, and its maze of tracks, added thirty-one officers plus three infantry and four cavalry banners for patrol and pacification.

sentences.zh: 十九年，以總兵官駐防綏定，統漢隊三千人，策應四境，若廣仁城、果子溝、三台、瞻德城、三道河、霍爾果斯、拱宸城、寧遠城，以馬步砲隊分防。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, a brigade general was stationed at Suiding commanding three thousand Han troops to coordinate the four borders—such as Guangren city, Guozigou, Santai, Zhande city, Sandao River, Khorgos, Gongchen city, and Ningyuan city—with cavalry, infantry, and gun teams divided for defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, a brigade general at Suiding commanded 3,000 Han troops covering the four marches, with cavalry, infantry, and artillery detachments posted at Guangren, Guozigou, Santai, Zhande, Sandao River, Khorgos, Gongchen, and Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，潘效蘇因新疆兵費過重，改練土著，遣散客軍。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, Pan Xiaosu because Xinjiang military expenses were too heavy, changed to drilling native inhabitants and dispersed guest armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, Pan Xiaosu, facing crushing military costs in Xinjiang, turned to training local recruits and disbanded outside contingents.

sentences.zh: 回纏民性各殊，以二三成攙入漢軍訓練，漢軍則各營旗皆減為哨，節餉防邊，始能兼顧。

translations.literal: Muslim frontier peoples' natures each differed; two or three tenths were mixed into Han army training, while the Han army's each camp and banner were all reduced to posts—economizing pay and defending the border, only then could both be attended to.
translations.idiomatic: Because frontier Muslim communities differed in character, two or three men in ten were folded into Han units for training, while Han banners were pared to squad strength so pay could be saved and the border still held.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，札拉豐阿因塔爾巴哈台屏蔽西北，以原有馬步砲隊，及左右旗蒙、滿隊，悉改新式操法。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong, Zhala Feng'a because Tacheng shielded the northwest, with existing cavalry-infantry-gun teams and left and right banner Mongol and Manchu teams, all changed to new-style drill methods.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 2, Zhala Feng'a retrained Tacheng's cavalry, infantry, artillery, and Mongol-Manchu banner units—all shielding the northwest—in modern drill.

sentences.zh: 時中朝方議減餉裁兵，未遑遠略。

translations.literal: At that time the court was debating reducing pay and cutting troops, with no leisure for distant strategy.
translations.idiomatic: The court was then absorbed in pay cuts and troop reductions and had little attention for frontier strategy.

sentences.zh: 俄羅斯正經營東陲，遂暫安無事雲。

translations.literal: Russia was then managing the eastern marches, and so for a time all was peaceful without incident—thus it ends.
translations.idiomatic: Russia was busy consolidating its eastern holdings, and the frontier enjoyed a brief calm—thus the account closes.

sentences.zh: 西藏初設駐藏大臣，而番眾仍統屬於喇嘛。

translations.literal: When Tibet first established a Resident in Tibet minister, the frontier peoples still remained uniformly subordinate to the lamas.
translations.idiomatic: Though a Resident Minister was first appointed to Tibet, the frontier population remained under lama rule.

sentences.zh: 當崇德七年，達賴、班禪與厄魯特同時入貢。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Chongde, the Dalai Lama, Panchen Lama, and Oirats simultaneously paid tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 7, the Dalai Lama, Panchen Lama, and Oirat leaders all presented tribute together.

sentences.zh: 順治、康熙間，朝請不絕。

translations.literal: Between Shunzhi and Kangxi, court audiences were unceasing.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the Shunzhi and Kangxi reigns, embassies to court never ceased.

sentences.zh: 康熙之季，準噶爾侵藏，由西寧進兵平之。

translations.literal: At the end of Kangxi, the Dzungars invaded Tibet; troops advanced from Xining and pacified it.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Kangxi reign the Dzungars invaded Tibet; Qing forces marched from Xining and restored order.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，弭噶隆之爭，以頗羅鼐有定亂功，進封郡王。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, Gyalrong strife was quelled; because Polhané had merit in settling disorder, he was advanced and enfeoffed as prince of a commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5, after quelling the Gyalrong conflict, Polhané was raised to princely rank for his service in restoring order.

sentences.zh: 十年，留雲南兵於察木多，以防番眾。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Yunnan troops were retained at Chamdo to guard against frontier peoples.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, a Yunnan detachment was left at Chamdo to watch the frontier tribes.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十五年，除頗羅鼐王爵，始設駐藏大臣，與達賴、班禪參互制之。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Qianlong, Polhané's princely rank was removed; a Resident in Tibet minister was first established to check the Dalai and Panchen mutually.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 15, Polhané was stripped of his title and a Resident Minister was installed to balance the Dalai and Panchen Lamas.

sentences.zh: 其西南之廓爾喀，時窺藏境，中朝以兵力佐之，收復巴勒布所侵佔藏地，增設塘汛守兵十三處，以寨落之多寡為衡，前藏增唐古特兵八百人，後藏增四百人。

translations.literal: To its southwest, Nepal at times peered at Tibetan territory; the court assisted with military force, recovered Tibetan lands the Gurkhas had invaded and occupied, increased river-post garrison troops at thirteen places with villages' many or few as the measure, front Tibet increased Tangut troops by eight hundred, rear Tibet by four hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Nepal to the southwest often eyed Tibetan territory; imperial troops helped recover Gurkha-occupied lands, added thirteen river-post garrisons scaled to local settlements, and raised Tibetan levies by 800 in front Tibet and 400 in the rear.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，始於前後藏各設番兵千人。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year, frontier troops of one thousand each were first established in front and rear Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year, 1,000-man Tibetan militia units were first formed in both front and rear Tibet.

sentences.zh: 其通內地之定日、江孜二處要隘，各設番兵五百人，就近選補。

translations.literal: At the vital passes of Dingri and Gyantse connecting to the interior, five hundred frontier troops each were established, selected and supplemented from nearby.
translations.idiomatic: At Dingri and Gyantse, the key gateways to inland China, 500 Tibetan troops apiece were stationed and filled from nearby districts.

sentences.zh: 設戴琫三人，以二人駐後藏，一人駐定日。

translations.literal: Three daibing were established, with two garrisoned in rear Tibet and one at Dingri.
translations.idiomatic: Three daibing officers were appointed—two in rear Tibet and one at Dingri.

sentences.zh: 增江孜戴琫一人。

translations.literal: One additional daibing was added at Gyantse.
translations.idiomatic: Gyantse received an additional daibing post.

sentences.zh: 前藏番兵隸駐防游擊，後藏番兵隸駐防都司。

translations.literal: Front Tibet's frontier troops were subordinate to the garrison mobile-strike officer; rear Tibet's frontier troops were subordinate to the garrison captain.
translations.idiomatic: Front-Tibetan militia answered to the garrison brigade officer; rear-Tibetan militia to the garrison captain.

sentences.zh: 令四川督臣以頭等將備為駐藏之選，統以大臣。

translations.literal: The Sichuan governor was ordered to choose first-rank generals and defenders for Tibet residency, all unified under the minister.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan governor was directed to nominate senior generals for Tibetan service, all under the Resident's command.

sentences.zh: 其駐藏之兵，令駐藏大臣親為校閱。

translations.literal: The troops stationed in Tibet were ordered to be personally inspected and reviewed by the Resident in Tibet minister.
translations.idiomatic: Troops in Tibet were to be inspected in person by the Resident Minister.

sentences.zh: 嗣因定日、江孜為各部落來藏必經之路，各增防汛，設守備等官。

translations.literal: Later, because Dingri and Gyantse were paths that all tribes coming to Tibet must pass, river-post defenses were increased at each and defender officers and others were established.
translations.idiomatic: Later, as Dingri and Gyantse lay on every tribe's route into Tibet, river-post defenses were strengthened and defender-grade officers appointed at both.

sentences.zh: 打箭爐之外，擇地設游擊等官。

translations.literal: Beyond Dartsendo, places were selected to establish mobile-strike officers and others.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond Dartsendo, mobile-strike officers and similar posts were placed at chosen sites.

sentences.zh: 五十八年，和琳等會勘後藏邊界及鄂博情形，江孜番、漢兵已敷防守，惟定日地方遼闊，為聶拉木、宗喀、絨轄三處總匯之區，其捷徑如轄爾多、古利噶等處，均為要隘，增設番兵，統以戴琫，修寨落以備棲止，立鄂博以守界畫。

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year, Helin and others jointly surveyed rear Tibet's border and obo conditions; Gyantse's frontier and Han troops already sufficed for defense, but only Dingri's region was vast, as the converging district of Nyalam, Zhongga, and Rongxia; its shortcuts such as Xia'erduo and Guliga were all vital passes—frontier troops were added, unified under the daibing, villages repaired for shelter, and obos established to guard the boundary demarcation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-eighth year, Helin and colleagues surveyed rear Tibet's borders and boundary markers. Gyantse was adequately manned, but vast Dingri—hub of Nyalam, Zhongga, and Rongxia and gateway by routes such as Xia'erduo and Guliga—received added militia under a daibing, repaired villages for shelter, and new obos to mark the frontier.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，懲治聶拉木、絨轄各營官私釋喇嘛之罪，別遣番兵補營兵之額。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang, the crime of Nyalam and Rongxia camp officers privately releasing lamas was punished; frontier troops were separately sent to fill the camp troops' quotas.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 2, officers at Nyalam and Rongxia were punished for unlawfully releasing lamas, and Tibetan militia replaced the disbanded camp rolls.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，令番兵習弓矢者，改習鳥槍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, frontier troops practicing bow and arrow were ordered to change to practicing matchlock guns.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, Tibetan troops trained in archery were ordered to take up muskets instead.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，令後藏大臣督率將弁教練堆葛爾本挖金番民武技。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, the rear Tibet minister was ordered to supervise and lead officers in training the martial skills of Derge and other gold-digging frontier peoples.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, the rear-Tibet minister was told to drill officers and train the fighting skills of Derge and other gold-mining frontier communities.

sentences.zh: 咸豐五年，以廓爾喀不靖，駐防兵單，令喇嘛等聯絡防範，調前藏僧俗土兵二千人赴策墊地方防範。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xianfeng, because Nepal was unrestful and garrison troops few, lamas and others were ordered to link defenses; two thousand front-Tibet monk, lay, and local troops were transferred to the Cejian region for defense.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 5, with Nepal restless and the garrison thin, lamas were enlisted in the defense network and 2,000 front-Tibetan monk, lay, and militia forces were sent to the Cejian sector.

sentences.zh: 同治四年，駐藏大臣滿慶等，調派土兵及統兵番員防備披楞。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tongzhi, the Resident Manqing and others transferred local troops and frontier officers commanding troops to defend Bhutan.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 4, Resident Manqing deployed local militia and Tibetan officers to guard the Bhutanese frontier.

sentences.zh: 八年，因披楞侵佔哲孟雄，與唐古特相持，令恩麟等整頓後藏番、漢營伍。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because Bhutan invaded and occupied Sikkim and deadlocked with the Tanguts, Enlin and others were ordered to rectify rear Tibet's frontier and Han camp ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, after Bhutan seized Sikkim and clashed with Tibetan forces, Enlin was ordered to reorganize rear Tibet's Tibetan and Han garrisons.

sentences.zh: 十一年，命德泰赴藏，校閱江孜、定日後藏三汛防營，以固哲孟雄及聶拉木門戶。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Detai was ordered to go to Tibet and inspect the three river-post defense camps of Gyantse, Dingri, and rear Tibet, to secure Sikkim and the gateways of Nyalam.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Detai was sent to Tibet to review the Gyantse, Dingri, and rear-Tibet river garrisons and shore up Sikkim and the Nyalam passes.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十四年，駐藏大臣文海因後藏定日地方營伍及靖西設防，駐藏大臣久未巡視，乃率兵親往各處校閱。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu, Resident Wenhai because rear Tibet's Dingri region camps and western-pacification defenses had long gone without the Resident's tour and inspection, thereupon led troops personally to each place to review.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 24, Resident Wenhai, finding that rear-Tibetan camps at Dingri and the western defense line had not been inspected for years, led troops in person to review every post.

sentences.zh: 光緒季年，駐藏大臣聯豫仿內地制，設武備學堂，擇營弁衛隊及達木三十九族中之優秀者，習速成科，俟畢業後，先練一營，以開風氣。

translations.literal: In the late Guangxu period, Resident Lian Yu imitated the interior system and established a military academy, selecting outstanding men from camp officers' guards and the thirty-nine tribes of Dam to study an accelerated course; after graduation, one battalion would first be drilled to open custom.
