translations.idiomatic: Late in Guangxu, Resident Lian Yu founded a military academy on the inland model, enrolling promising officers' guardsmen and youths from the thirty-nine Dam tribes in a crash course; one battalion would be trained first upon graduation to set the example.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，聯豫因工布平定，以馬步砲隊工程隊分地駐守。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong, Lian Yu because Kongpo was pacified, with cavalry-infantry-gun and engineering teams divided by territory for garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 2, with Kongpo subdued, Lian Yu distributed cavalry, infantry, artillery, and engineer detachments across the region.

sentences.zh: 旋疏請裁去幫辦大臣，設左右參贊，分駐前後藏。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized requesting to abolish the assistant minister, establish left and right counselors, and separately garrison front and rear Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: He soon memorialized to abolish the assistant minister, create left and right counselors, and station them in front and rear Tibet respectively.

sentences.zh: 三年，波密野番滋事，即以工布之兵剿辦，並以步隊擇地駐防，為各營後援。

translations.literal: In the third year, Bomi wild frontier people stirred trouble; Kongpo troops were used to suppress it, and infantry selected places for garrison as rear support for each camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, unrest among wild tribes in Bomi was suppressed with Kongpo troops, while infantry detachments were posted as a reserve behind the main camps.

sentences.zh: 至川軍入藏之舉，始於雍正初年，準噶爾窺邊，詔以川、陝兵二千人駐防，設正副大臣，分駐前後藏。

translations.literal: As for the measure of Sichuan troops entering Tibet, it began in the early years of Yongzheng; the Dzungars peered at the border; an edict ordered two thousand Sichuan and Shaanxi troops to garrison, establishing chief and deputy ministers separately stationed in front and rear Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan troops first entered Tibet in early Yongzheng, when Dzungar pressure on the border prompted an edict posting 2,000 Sichuan and Shaanxi men under chief and deputy ministers in front and rear Tibet.

sentences.zh: 其時雲南省軍隊亦分途入藏。

translations.literal: At that time Yunnan province's army also entered Tibet by divided routes.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan forces entered Tibet at the same time by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 事定，仍撤歸原省。

translations.literal: When affairs were settled, they were still withdrawn and returned to their original provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Once order was restored, all were withdrawn to their home provinces.

sentences.zh: 歷朝鎮撫藏地，多用漢軍、番卒。

translations.literal: Successive dynasties in pacifying Tibet much used Han armies and frontier soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Dynasty after dynasty had relied chiefly on Han troops and Tibetan levies to hold Tibet.

sentences.zh: 至光緒三十一年，四川督臣錫良奏調川軍出打箭爐，並招募土勇為嚮導，以剿竄回。

translations.literal: By the thirty-first year of Guangxu, Sichuan governor Xiliang memorialized transferring Sichuan troops out of Dartsendo and recruiting local braves as guides to suppress fleeing Muslim bandits.
translations.idiomatic: By Guangxu 31, Governor Xiliang of Sichuan had moved Sichuan troops through Dartsendo and enlisted local guides to hunt down roving Muslim rebels.

sentences.zh: 是年八月，巴塘喇嘛戕害大臣，全藏震動。

translations.literal: That year in the eighth month, Batang lamas killed the minister and all Tibet was shaken.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of that year, lamas at Batang murdered the imperial commissioner, convulsing the whole plateau.

sentences.zh: 四川提督馬維祺、建昌道趙爾豐合兵進克巴塘、里塘，勘平邊亂。

translations.literal: Sichuan brigade general Ma Weiji and Jiancheng circuit intendant Zhao Erfeng combined troops, advanced and took Batang and Litang, surveyed and pacified the border disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan brigade general Ma Weiji and circuit intendant Zhao Erfeng of Jiancheng advanced together, recovered Batang and Litang, and pacified the border uprising.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，里塘逆番桑披復率眾倡亂，錫良命趙爾豐等以川軍討平之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, the rebellious monk Samdup at Litang again led the masses and raised disorder; Xiliang ordered Zhao Erfeng and others with Sichuan troops to suppress and pacify it.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year, the rebel lama Samdup at Litang rose again; Xiliang sent Zhao Erfeng and Sichuan troops to crush the revolt.

sentences.zh: 其時番僧與北部回民日就衰弱，全藏邊境，為英吉利、俄羅斯遠勢所包，藏事遂不可問雲。

translations.literal: At that time frontier monks and northern Hui people daily grew weaker; all Tibet's border was wrapped by the distant power of England and Russia—Tibetan affairs then became beyond inquiry—thus it ends.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetan clergy and northern Muslim communities were weakening daily, while British and Russian pressure closed in on every frontier pass—Tibet's fate was no longer in Qing hands—thus the account closes.

sentences.zh: 苗疆當貴州、湖南之境，叛服靡常，歷朝皆剿撫兼施。

translations.literal: The Miao frontier lies at the borders of Guizhou and Hunan; rebellion and submission are unceasing, and successive dynasties all applied suppression and soothing together.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao frontier straddled Guizhou and Hunan, where tribes alternated between revolt and submission; every dynasty had paired force with conciliation.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十八年，以鎮筸居苗疆衝要，改沅州鎮為鎮筸鎮，設總兵以下各官，增額兵千人，合原有之兵凡二千一百人，以防紅苗。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year of Kangxi, because Zhenqian occupied the Miao frontier chokepoint, Yuanzhou garrison was changed to Zhenqian garrison, establishing a brigade general and subordinates, increasing quota troops by one thousand; together with original troops in all twenty-one hundred, to guard against the Red Miao.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 38, Zhenqian's strategic position on the Miao marches prompted renaming the Yuanzhou garrison as Zhenqian, with a brigade general and staff, 1,000 added to the rolls, and 2,100 men in all to hold the Red Miao in check.

sentences.zh: 雍正九年，復增兵二千人。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Yongzheng, troops were again increased by two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 9, the garrison was reinforced by another 2,000 men.

sentences.zh: 是年，鄂爾泰因都江與清水江形勢劃分，增設清江鎮標，以新設之丹江、台拱等營，及原有之銅仁、鎮遠等營，咸隸清江鎮。

translations.literal: That year, Ortai because the Dujiang and Qingshui River terrain was divided, increased and established the Qingjiang brigade standard; the newly established Danjiang, Taigong, and other camps, together with the original Tongren, Zhenyuan, and other camps, all were subordinate to Qingjiang garrison.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ortai, noting how the Duliu and Qingshui rivers divided the terrain, created the Qingjiang brigade, placing new posts at Danjiang and Taigong alongside older camps at Tongren and Zhenyuan under its command.

sentences.zh: 而以都勻、黎平，並上江、下江各協、營，隸於古州鎮總兵。

translations.literal: And with Duyun, Liping, plus upper and lower river each brigades and camps, subordinate to the Guzhou garrison brigade general.
translations.idiomatic: Duyun, Liping, and the upper- and lower-river brigades and camps were placed under the brigade general at Guzhou.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，楊名時銳意治苗，以貴州省苗眾分生熟二苗，生苗在南，熟苗在北，乃屯駐重兵於內地，而擇鄰苗之要道，增修壁壘，使民有所歸，兵有可守，遇苗眾出巢滋事，則互相援剿，戰勝勿事窮追，兼撫熟苗，俾漸知向化。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, Yang Mingshi keenly governed the Miao; because Guizhou province's Miao masses were divided into raw and cooked Miao, raw Miao in the south and cooked in the north, he then massed heavy troops in the interior, selected vital roads neighboring the Miao, increased and repaired ramparts, so the people had where to return and troops had what to defend; when Miao masses left their nests and stirred trouble, they mutually aided in suppression; on victory he did not pursue to extremity; he also soothed the cooked Miao so they gradually knew to turn toward civilization.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1, Yang Mingshi pressed a systematic Miao policy: Guizhou's tribes were classed as "raw" in the south and "cooked" in the north. He massed troops inland, fortified key approaches, gave settlers protected villages, and garrisoned defensible posts. When raw Miao raided, neighboring units supported one another but were told not to pursue to annihilation, while cooked Miao were conciliated toward allegiance.

sentences.zh: 五年，那蘇圖因永順所屬，緊接苗疆，且與湖北省之容美土司、四川省之酉陽土司連界，乃以永順協標兵改隸鎮筸鎮總兵，聯絡楚南聲勢，合力防苗。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Nasutu because Yongshun's subordinates tightly adjoined the Miao frontier and shared a border with Hubei's Rongmei chieftain and Sichuan's Youyang chieftain, then Yongshun brigade standard troops were changed to be subordinate to the Zhenqian garrison brigade general, linking Chu-south prestige and combining force to guard the Miao.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Nasutu, noting that Yongshun abutted the Miao frontier and bordered the Rongmei chieftain in Hubei and the Youyang chieftain in Sichuan, transferred Yongshun's brigade troops to Zhenqian's command to link Hunan's southern defenses against the Miao.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初年，戡定苗疆以後，於鳳凰、乾州、永綏、古丈坪、保靖各廳縣，沿邊次第建修屯堡碉台，築邊牆以嚴界畫，築土堡以資守御，築哨台以憑瞭望，碉卡則戰守咸資，砲台則堵截尤利。

translations.literal: In the early years of Jiaqing, after pacifying the Miao frontier, at Fenghuang, Qianzhou, Yongshou, Guzhangping, and Baojing each prefecture and county, along the border in turn were built garrison forts and watch towers, a border wall to tighten the boundary demarcation, earthen forts for defense, sentry towers for lookout—blockhouses served both battle and guard, cannon platforms especially benefited blocking.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jiaqing, after the Miao frontier was pacified, Fenghuang, Qianzhou, Yongshou, Guzhangping, and Baojing built garrison forts and watchtowers along the line, border walls to mark the frontier, earthen strongpoints for defense, and lookout posts—blockhouses for fighting and holding, batteries especially for blocking passes.

sentences.zh: 設練勇千餘人，屯丁七千人，墾闢屯防田十三萬一千餘畝，悉以屯兵耕種。

translations.literal: Drilled braves of more than one thousand and garrison settlers of seven thousand were established; garrison-defense fields of more than one hundred thirty-one thousand mu were opened—all cultivated by garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: Over 1,000 drilled militia and 7,000 settler-soldiers were posted, and more than 131,000 mu of garrison farmland opened, all tilled by the troops themselves.

sentences.zh: 其地皆附近碉堡，以便駐守，且節餉糈。

translations.literal: Their lands were all near blockhouses for convenient garrison and also to economize pay and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Plots lay close to the forts for easy defense and to cut the cost of rations.

sentences.zh: 歷嘉、道兩朝，沿邊寧謐。

translations.literal: Through the Jiaqing and Daoguang reigns, along the border all was tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Through the Jiaqing and Daoguang eras the frontier remained quiet.

sentences.zh: 咸豐軍興以後，苗眾乘機肆擾。

translations.literal: After military rise in Xianfeng, Miao masses seized the opportunity and wildly harassed.
translations.idiomatic: After the wars of the Xianfeng era, Miao bands took advantage of the turmoil to raid at will.

sentences.zh: 至同治年，席寶田等大舉平苗，雖間有剽掠之事，以防勇隨時剿撫。

translations.literal: By the Tongzhi years, Xi Baotian and others massively pacified the Miao; though occasionally plundering occurred, defense braves timely suppressed and soothed.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tongzhi period Xi Baotian and others conducted a major Miao campaign; sporadic looting was handled by local defense forces through prompt suppression or conciliation.

sentences.zh: 光緒十二年，譚鈞培因苗民馴擾無常，乃仿傅鼐防苗之法，增修石碉土堡，由附郭而漸及山林險阻之處，互為守望，以備苗民出入，於舊日之苗疆營制，無所變更也。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Guangxu, Tan Junpei because Miao people were tame yet harassed without constancy, then imitated Fu Nao's method of guarding the Miao, increased and repaired stone blockhouses and earthen forts, from the vicinity of seats gradually reaching mountain forests and dangerous places, mutually watching and guarding to prepare for Miao coming and going—in the old Miao frontier camp system, nothing was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 12, Tan Junpei, finding Miao communities alternately submissive and predatory, followed Fu Nao's frontier model and added stone and earthen forts from the county seats into the hills, with mutual watch posts to control movement—without altering the older Miao garrison structure.

sentences.zh: 沿邊墩台、卡倫、鄂博、碉堡，清初於各省邊境扼要處，設立墩台營房，有警則守兵舉煙為號。

translations.literal: Along-border beacon towers, karun posts, obos, and blockhouses—in early Qing at each province's border chokepoints, beacon towers and camp buildings were established; on alarm the garrison troops raised smoke as signal.
translations.idiomatic: Border beacon towers, karun posts, obos, and blockhouses: in early Qing, critical points on provincial frontiers were furnished with beacon towers and barracks whose garrisons lit signal fires at the first alarm.

sentences.zh: 寇至百人者，掛一席，鳴一砲；

translations.literal: When bandits reached one hundred, one mat was hung and one cannon fired;
translations.idiomatic: A force of one hundred raiders was signaled by one banner mat and one gunshot;

sentences.zh: 至三百人者，掛二席，鳴二砲；

translations.literal: when they reached three hundred, two mats were hung and two cannon fired;
translations.idiomatic: three hundred by two mats and two shots;

sentences.zh: 至五百人者，掛三席，鳴三砲；

translations.literal: when they reached five hundred, three mats were hung and three cannon fired;
translations.idiomatic: five hundred raiders called for three banner mats and three gunshots;

sentences.zh: 至千人者，掛五席，鳴五砲；

translations.literal: when they reached one thousand, five mats were hung and five cannon fired;
translations.idiomatic: one thousand by five mats and five shots;

sentences.zh: 至萬人者，掛七席，連砲傳遞。

translations.literal: when they reached ten thousand, seven mats were hung, cannon passed relay upon relay;
translations.idiomatic: ten thousand triggered seven mats and guns relayed in chain along the beacon line;

sentences.zh: 康熙七年，諭各省將領，凡水陸孔道之旁，均設墩台營房，駐宿兵丁，傳報緊急軍機，稽察匪類，護衛行人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Kangxi, [the throne] instructed the generals of each province that beside every land and water thoroughfare beacon mounds, towers, and camp buildings were to be set up uniformly, garrison soldiers billeted, urgent military matters reported and transmitted, bandit sorts examined and checked, and travelers guarded and protected.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 7 an edict went to provincial commanders to post beacon towers and barracks along every major route by land or water, with troops housed there to relay urgent dispatches, hunt bandits, and protect travelers.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三年，兵部議定汛兵缺少處，按地方★僻情形，酌量撥補器械，務令整備，隨時察驗。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qianlong, the Board of War resolved that where rotating garrison troops were lacking, according to each place's remote circumstances arms were to be allocated as appropriate and equipment must be kept complete, inspected at all times.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 3 the Ministry of War ordered that shortages in frontier garrisons be made up with arms suited to local remoteness, with kit kept complete and inspected regularly.

sentences.zh: 有離汛誤防者革責，官吏嚴懲之。

translations.literal: Those who left their rotation post and failed in defense were cashiered and punished; officials were severely penalized.
translations.idiomatic: Troops who abandoned post faced demotion and discipline; their officers faced stern punishment.

sentences.zh: 其軍台之制，始於順治四年，自張家口迤西，黃河迤東，設台三百四十四座，台軍七百三十二名。

translations.literal: The system of military relay stations began in the fourth year of Shunzhi; from Zhangjiakou westward and east of the Yellow River, three hundred forty-four stations were set up, with seven hundred thirty-two station troops.
translations.idiomatic: Military relay stations dated from Shunzhi 4: from Zhangjiakou west and east of the Yellow River, 344 stations manned by 732 relay troops.

sentences.zh: 自張家口迄山海關迤西，設台四百十七座，台車一千二百五十一名。

translations.literal: From Zhangjiakou to Shanhaiguan and westward, four hundred seventeen stations were set up, with one thousand two hundred fifty-one station-cart personnel.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhangjiakou to Shanhaiguan and beyond, 417 stations with 1,251 relay-cart crews.

sentences.zh: 蒙古各旗台、卡、鄂博之制，以大漠一望無垠，凡內外札薩克之游牧，各限以界，或以鄂博，或以卡倫。

translations.literal: The system of stations, karun, and obos in the Mongol banners: because the great desert was boundless without limit, for the nomadism of inner and outer jasak each was confined to a boundary, either by obo or by karun.
translations.idiomatic: In the Mongol leagues, relay stations, karun posts, and obos marked a steppe without landmarks: every inner and outer jasak was allotted grazing bounds, defined by obos or karun as the case required.

sentences.zh: 盛京、吉林則以柳條邊為界，依內興安嶺而設。

translations.literal: Shengjing and Jilin took the Willow Palisade as boundary, set up according to the Inner Khingan range.
translations.idiomatic: In Shengjing and Jilin the Willow Palisade formed the line, with posts aligned along the Inner Khingan.

sentences.zh: 其內蒙古通驛要口凡五道，曰喜峰口、古北口、獨石口、張家口、殺虎口，以達於各旗。

translations.literal: For important courier routes through Inner Mongolia there were in all five passages, namely Xifengkou, Gubeikou, Dushikou, Zhangjiakou, and Shankou, reaching the various banners.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Mongolia was served by five great courier passes—Xifengkou, Gubeikou, Dushikou, Zhangjiakou, and Shankou—linking the banners.

sentences.zh: 內蒙路近，商旅通行，水草無艱。

translations.literal: Inner Mongolia's roads were near; merchants and travelers passed; water and pasture were without hardship.
translations.idiomatic: Routes in Inner Mongolia were short, travel easy, and fodder plentiful.

sentences.zh: 其外蒙古之驛，則由阿爾泰軍台以達於邊境各卡倫。

translations.literal: The relay stations of Outer Mongolia then ran from the Altai military relay line to reach each border karun.
translations.idiomatic: Outer Mongol relays extended from the Altai military line to frontier karun posts.

sentences.zh: 康熙朝征準噶爾時，設定邊左副將軍，而外蒙古軍台之設，由內而外，其制始密。

translations.literal: In the Kangxi reign when campaigning against the Zunghars, a frontier deputy commander-in-chief on the left was established at the border; and the setting up of Outer Mongol military stations, from inner to outer, made the system first dense.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zunghar campaigns Kangxi appointed a frontier deputy commander and built Outer Mongol relay stations from the interior outward, tightening the network.

sentences.zh: 自察哈爾而北，而西北，而又西，迄烏里雅蘇台，共置四十八台。

translations.literal: From Chahar northward, northwestward, then westward, reaching Uliastai, in all forty-eight stations were placed.
translations.idiomatic: From Chahar north and northwest to Uliastai, forty-eight stations were established.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十一年，自古北口至烏珠木秦，置台九。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year of Kangxi, from Gubeikou to Uzhumuchin, nine stations were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 31 added nine stations from Gubeikou to Uzhumuchin.

sentences.zh: 自獨石口至浩齊忒，置台六。

translations.literal: From Dushikou to Khoqit, six stations were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Six stations linked Dushikou and Khoqit.

sentences.zh: 自張家口至四子部落，置台五。

translations.literal: From Zhangjiakou to the Four-Banner Tribe, five stations were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Five stations ran from Zhangjiakou to the Sizi tribe.

sentences.zh: 自張家口至歸化城，置台六。

translations.literal: From Zhangjiakou to Guihua Cheng, six stations were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Six stations connected Zhangjiakou and Guihua Cheng.

sentences.zh: 自殺虎口至吳喇忒，置台九。

translations.literal: From Shankou to Urad, nine stations were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Nine stations spanned Shankou and Urad.

sentences.zh: 自歸化城至鄂爾多斯，置台八。

translations.literal: From Guihua Cheng to Ordos, eight stations were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Eight stations ran from Guihua Cheng into Ordos.

sentences.zh: 自喜峰口至扎賴特，置台十六。

translations.literal: From Xifengkou to Zhalaid, sixteen stations were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen stations linked Xifengkou and Zhalaid.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十四年，自喜峰口路扎賴特盡處起，置台十四。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year of Qianlong, from where the Xifengkou route ended at Zhalaid, fourteen stations were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 34 extended the Xifengkou–Zhalaid line with fourteen new stations beyond its former terminus.

sentences.zh: 自古北口路烏珠木秦盡處起，置台六。

translations.literal: From where the Gubeikou route ended at Uzhumuchin, six stations were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Six stations were added beyond the Gubeikou–Uzhumuchin endpoint.

sentences.zh: 自殺虎口路吳喇忒大路外起，置台七。

translations.literal: From beyond the main road of the Shankou route at Urad, seven stations were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Seven stations were placed past the Shankou–Urad highway.

sentences.zh: 自張家口路四子部落盡處起，置台十六。

translations.literal: From where the Zhangjiakou route ended at the Four-Banner Tribe, sixteen stations were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen stations continued the Zhangjiakou–Sizi line beyond its old limit.

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀則自備郵站。

translations.literal: Khalkha then prepared their own postal stations.
translations.idiomatic: Khalkha maintained its own relay posts.

sentences.zh: 其東路首站曰尼爾得尼拖羅海，西路首站曰哈拉尼敦，後路首站曰肯特山。

translations.literal: Its eastern route's first station was called Nierdeni Tuoluo Hai, the western route's first station Halanidun, the rear route's first station Kent Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern line began at Nierdeni Tuoluo Hai, the western at Halanidun, and the rear at Kent Shan.

sentences.zh: 迤邐而北，直抵三音諾顏境，其首站曰博羅布爾哈蘇。

translations.literal: Winding northward, reaching straight to the territory of Setsen Khan, its first station was called Boluobuer Hasu.
translations.idiomatic: A northern branch wound to Setsen Khan country, opening at Boluobuer Hasu.

sentences.zh: 凡汗、王、貝勒過境，警晨夜，飼牲畜。

translations.literal: Whenever khans, princes, or beile passed through, they kept watch morning and night and fed livestock.
translations.idiomatic: When khans, wang, or beile traveled the line, posts kept day-and-night watch and tended their herds.

sentences.zh: 商旅出其途，亦資捍衛焉。

translations.literal: Merchants and travelers going out by their routes also relied on such guarding and protection.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants on the same roads gained protection as well.

sentences.zh: 圍場卡倫之制，規取高地為之，或於岡，或於阪，或于山川之隙，隨宜設置。

translations.literal: The system of hunting-preserve karun: planning took high ground for them, either on knolls, or on slopes, or in gaps of mountains and rivers, set up as suited to conditions.
translations.idiomatic: Hunting-preserve karun were sited on high ground—ridge, slope, or river gap—as terrain dictated.

sentences.zh: 其柳條邊境之設立卡倫者，東為崖口，西為濟爾哈朗圖，北為色堪達巴漢色欽等處，又西為庫爾圖羅海等處，又南為木壘喀喇沁等處，又南而西為珠爾噶岱等處，又南為海拉蘇台等處，又南而東為巴倫克得依等處。

translations.literal: Where karun were established on the Willow Palisade border: east was Yankou, west Jierhalangtu, north Sekandabahan Seqin and other places, again west Kurtuluohai and other places, again south Mulei Kalaqin and other places, again south then west Zhuergadai and other places, again south Hailasutai and other places, again south then east Balunkedeyi and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Along the Willow Palisade, karun stood at Yankou in the east, Jierhalangtu in the west, Sekandabahan Seqin and like points in the north, then Kurtuluohai, Mulei Kalaqin, Zhuergadai, Hailasutai, and Balunkedeyi farther south and west.

sentences.zh: 老柳邊在外，卡倫在內。

translations.literal: The old willow border was outside; karun were inside.
translations.idiomatic: The old palisade lay outward; the karun ring lay within it.

sentences.zh: 其故地在周阹之中者，為翁牛特，為哈喇沁，為敖漢，為奈曼，為喀爾喀，左翼等故地咸在焉。

translations.literal: Their former lands within the surrounding enclosure were Ongniud, Kharachin, Aohan, Naiman, Khalkha, Left Wing, and the like—all former territories were therein.
translations.idiomatic: Within the enclosure lay the old domains of Ongniud, Kharachin, Aohan, Naiman, Khalkha Left Wing, and others.

sentences.zh: 其恰克圖及沿邊鄂博、卡倫之制，因山河以表鄂博，無山河則表以卡倫。

translations.literal: The system of Kyakhta and along-border obos and karun: relying on mountains and rivers to mark obos; where there were no mountains and rivers, marking by karun.
translations.idiomatic: At Kyakhta and along the frontier, obos followed rivers and ridges where nature allowed; otherwise karun marked the line.

sentences.zh: 鄂博者，華言石堆也。

translations.literal: An obo—in Chinese speech, a stone heap.
translations.idiomatic: Obo, in Chinese, means a cairn of stones.

sentences.zh: 其制有二：以壘為鄂博，以山河為鄂博。

translations.literal: Its forms were two: taking ramparts as obo, taking mountains and rivers as obo.
translations.idiomatic: Two kinds existed: piled-stone obos and obos defined by natural features.

sentences.zh: 蒙古二十五部落，察哈爾牧廠八旗各如其境，以鄂博為防。

translations.literal: Mongolia's twenty-five tribes, Chahar pasture-factory Eight Banners each according to its territory, used obos as defense.
translations.idiomatic: All twenty-five tribes and the eight Chahar pasture banners marked their pastures with obos as boundary defense.

sentences.zh: 其與俄羅斯接界，中間隙地，蒙古語曰薩布。

translations.literal: Where they bordered Russia, the gap-land in between—in Mongol speech, sabu.
translations.idiomatic: The neutral strip between Qing and Russian territory was called sabu in Mongol.

sentences.zh: 凡薩布皆立鄂博以申畫之。

translations.literal: Every sabu all set up obos to extend and draw the line.
translations.idiomatic: Every sabu zone was delineated with obos.

sentences.zh: 恰克圖之中、俄邊界，凡俄國卡倫、房屋，在鄂爾懷圖山頂，中國鄂博、卡倫，適中而平分之。

translations.literal: At Kyakhta's Chinese–Russian border, all Russia's karun and houses were on Erhuaitu mountain's summit; China's obos and karun, at the middle, were halved and divided.
translations.idiomatic: At Kyakhta, Russian karun and dwellings stood on Erhuaitu peak while Chinese obos and karun were placed at the midpoint to divide the border evenly.

sentences.zh: 如有山河，即橫斷山河為界。

translations.literal: If there were mountains and rivers, then cutting across mountains and rivers as boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Where mountains or rivers existed, the boundary cut straight across them.

sentences.zh: 由沙畢納依嶺至額爾古訥河岸，向陽為中國，背陰為俄國。

translations.literal: From Shabinay ridge to the Ergun riverbank, sun-facing was China, shade-facing was Russia.
translations.idiomatic: From Shabinay ridge to the Ergun, the sunny bank was Chinese and the shady bank Russian.

sentences.zh: 蓋沿邊之地，自黑龍江、庫倫、烏里雅蘇台、科布多四屬迤邐而西，凡八十二卡倫。

translations.literal: For along-border lands, from Heilongjiang, Urga, Uliastai, Kobdo four jurisdictions winding westward, in all eighty-two karun.
translations.idiomatic: Along the frontier from Heilongjiang, Urga, Uliastai, and Kobdo westward there were eighty-two karun in all.

sentences.zh: 科布多所屬極西之卡倫，曰和尼邁拉呼。

translations.literal: Kobdo jurisdiction's westernmost karun was called Henimailahu.
translations.idiomatic: Kobdo's farthest western karun was Henimailahu.

sentences.zh: 由此渡額爾齊斯河至輝邁拉呼一帶卡倫，均與俄羅斯接壤。

translations.literal: From here crossing the Irtysh River to the belt of karun at Huimailahu, all bordered Russia.
translations.idiomatic: From there across the Irtysh to the Huimailahu line, every karun faced Russian territory.

sentences.zh: 其在黑龍江境內之卡倫，以將軍轄之。

translations.literal: Those karun within Heilongjiang territory were overseen by the general.
translations.idiomatic: Karun in Heilongjiang fell under the frontier general.

sentences.zh: 在蒙古喀爾喀等部落之卡倫，按其游牧遠近，每卡倫設章京一員，率兵攜眷戍守。

translations.literal: Karun in Mongolia's Khalkha and other tribes, according to the nearness or distance of their nomadism, at each karun one janggin was set, leading soldiers with families to garrison and guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the Khalkha and other Mongol steppes each karun had a janggin commanding troops and families according to grazing distances.

sentences.zh: 遇森林叢雜，難立鄂博、卡倫之處，則削大樹而刊識之。

translations.literal: Where encountering dense forest thickets and difficult to set up obos and karun, then they shaved great trees and carved marks for recognition.
translations.idiomatic: In thick forest where obos or karun could not stand, great trees were blazed and carved as markers.

sentences.zh: 自同治七年裁撤科布多境內卡倫以後，各項哈薩克人赴界強據。

translations.literal: From after the seventh year of Tongzhi, when karun within Kobdo territory were cut and removed, various Kazakh people went to the border and forcibly occupied.
translations.idiomatic: After Tongzhi 7 abolished Kobdo's karun, Kazakh groups seized the frontier by force.

sentences.zh: 光緒初年，乃於烏克克等處，由沁達蓋圖烏爾魯向西南至馬尼嘎圖勒幹止，與塔爾巴哈台卡倫相接，一千數百里之要隘，與俄羅斯接壤者，均設卡倫。

translations.literal: In the early Guangxu years, then at Wukeke and other places, from Qindagaitu Wuluru southwest to Manigatu Legan stopping, connecting with Tarbagatai karun, one thousand-odd li of strategic passes bordering Russia—all set up karun.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Guangxu, karun were restored from Wukeke through Qindagaitu Wuluru southwest to Manigatu Legan, linking Tarbagatai and guarding more than a thousand li of Russian frontier.

sentences.zh: 所有協理台吉等員，咸復舊制。

translations.literal: All assistant taiji and other personnel were entirely restored to the old system.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant taiji and related posts were all reinstated under the former regulations.

sentences.zh: 其新疆全境之卡倫，分南北二路。

translations.literal: Xinjiang whole territory's karun were divided into south and north two routes.
translations.idiomatic: Xinjiang's karun were organized in northern and southern sectors.

sentences.zh: 北路之塔爾巴哈台，與科布多毗連，以額爾齊斯河為界，河東卡倫隸科布多，河西卡倫隸塔爾巴哈台。

translations.literal: The northern route's Tarbagatai, adjoining Kobdo, took the Irtysh River as boundary; east-of-river karun were subordinate to Kobdo, west-of-river karun subordinate to Tarbagatai.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Tarbagatai adjoined Kobdo along the Irtysh: karun east of the river answered to Kobdo, those west to Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 自輝邁拉呼至塔城，夏季設大小卡倫十三處，冬季設卡倫八處。

translations.literal: From Huimailahu to Tacheng, in summer thirteen large and small karun were set up, in winter eight karun.
translations.idiomatic: From Huimailahu to Tacheng the garrison ran thirteen large and small karun in summer and eight in winter.

sentences.zh: 此外皆哈薩克游牧之地。

translations.literal: Beyond this all was Kazakh nomad land.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond those posts lay Kazakh pasture.

sentences.zh: 塔城西南一帶卡倫八處，界連伊犁。

translations.literal: Tacheng southwest belt eight karun, border connecting Ili.
translations.idiomatic: Eight karun southwest of Tacheng bordered Ili.

sentences.zh: 卡倫以外，為哈薩克游牧。

translations.literal: Outside the karun was Kazakh nomadism.
translations.idiomatic: Past the karun line Kazakh herds ranged freely.

sentences.zh: 伊犁東北七百餘里，與塔城接界之處，由哈布塔海達闌一帶而南，設大小卡倫二十三處。

translations.literal: Ili northeast more than seven hundred li, where it joined Tacheng's border, from the belt of Habutai Dalan southward, twenty-three large and small karun were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Some seven hundred li northeast of Ili, along the Tacheng frontier from Habutai Dalan southward, stood twenty-three large and small karun.

sentences.zh: 此外亦哈薩克游牧。

translations.literal: Beyond this also Kazakh nomadism.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond them again was Kazakh pasture.

sentences.zh: 又西而南，至伊犁河北岸，設大小卡倫八處，乃索倫領隊大臣專轄。

translations.literal: Again west then south, reaching Ili River's north bank, eight large and small karun were set up, solely overseen by the Solon commandant-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west and south to the north bank of the Ili River, eight karun fell under the Solon commandant.

sentences.zh: 自伊犁河南而西，設大小卡倫十六處，乃錫伯領隊大臣專轄。

translations.literal: From south of the Ili River westward, sixteen large and small karun were set up, solely overseen by the Xibe commandant-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen karun west of the southern Ili were commanded by the Xibe commandant.

sentences.zh: 卡倫之外，與哈薩克接壤。

translations.literal: Outside the karun, bordering the Kazakh.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the karun lay Kazakh territory.

sentences.zh: 其錫伯屯牧西南，因有回子屯所，每年夏秋設卡倫於達耳達木圖，以資巡察。

translations.literal: Its Xibe settled pasture southwest, because there were Hui settled encampments, every year summer and autumn set karun at Da'erdamutu for patrol inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of the Xibe settlements, near Hui farming colonies, seasonal karun at Da'erdamutu patrolled each summer and autumn.

sentences.zh: 由錫伯卡倫迤西轉南而東，設大小卡倫十七處，乃厄魯特領隊大臣專轄。

translations.literal: From Xibe karun winding west turning south then east, seventeen large and small karun were set up, solely overseen by the Olot commandant-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen karun west, south, and east of the Xibe line were held by the Olot commandant.

sentences.zh: 西南為布魯特游牧，西北為哈薩克游牧。

translations.literal: Southwest was Kyrgyz nomadism, northwest was Kazakh nomadism.
translations.idiomatic: Kyrgyz grazed to the southwest, Kazakhs to the northwest.

sentences.zh: 又厄魯特游牧東南，界連喀喇沙爾之土爾扈特、和碩特游牧，設大小卡倫八處，亦厄魯特領隊大臣專轄。

translations.literal: Again Olot nomadism southeast, border connecting Karashahr's Torghut and Khoshut nomadism, eight large and small karun were set up, also solely overseen by the Olot commandant-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Eight more karun on the Olot southeast flank, facing Torghut and Khoshut pastures of Karashahr, likewise answered to the Olot commandant.

sentences.zh: 其伊犁城北塔耳奇一帶，及伊犁河渡口，設卡倫七處，專為哈薩克貿易交通，並稽察逃人而設，乃惠寧領隊大臣專轄。

translations.literal: Its Ili city north Ta'erqi belt, and Ili River crossing places, seven karun were set up, solely for Kazakh trade communication and also to examine and check fugitives—set up for this, solely overseen by the Huining commandant-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Seven karun north of Ili city at Ta'erqi and the river crossings, under the Huining commandant, guarded Kazakh trade routes and hunted fugitives.

sentences.zh: 此伊犁及塔爾巴哈台大小卡倫之方向也。

translations.literal: This was the orientation of Ili and Tarbagatai large and small karun.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the disposition of karun in Ili and Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 其南路自伊犁南經木蘇耳達巴罕至回疆烏什城西北一帶，設卡倫六處，外通布魯特，乃烏什辦事大臣專轄。

translations.literal: Its southern route from Ili south passing Musuer Dabahan to the Muslim frontier Wushi city northwest belt, six karun were set up, outward connecting Kyrgyz, solely overseen by the Wushi resident minister.
translations.idiomatic: The southern line ran from Ili over Musuer Dabahan to northwest Ush, where six karun under the Ush minister opened toward Kyrgyz country.

sentences.zh: 自烏什而西，經草地及布魯特游牧地樹窩子等處七百餘里，直達喀什噶爾城，由城東北而西轉南，設卡倫十七處，外通布魯特，西達霍罕安集延，乃喀什噶爾領隊大臣專轄。

translations.literal: From Wushi westward, passing grassland and Kyrgyz nomad land Shuwuzi and other places more than seven hundred li, reaching straight to Kashgar city, from the city's northeast westward turning south, seventeen karun were set up, outward connecting Kyrgyz, west reaching Kokand and Andijan, solely overseen by the Kashgar commandant-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: West from Ush, seven hundred li through steppe and Kyrgyz pasture to Kashgar, seventeen karun under the Kashgar commandant faced Kyrgyz lands and the routes to Kokand and Andijan.

sentences.zh: 自喀什噶爾東南行二百餘里，至英吉沙爾城，由城西北而南，設卡倫十二處，外通布魯特，西南行千數百里，至巴達克山，乃英吉沙爾領隊大臣專轄。

translations.literal: From Kashgar southeast going two hundred-odd li, to Yengisar city, from the city's northwest southward, twelve karun were set up, outward connecting Kyrgyz, southwest going thousand-odd li to Badakhshan, solely overseen by the Yengisar commandant-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred li southeast of Kashgar, Yengisar's twelve karun, under its commandant, watched Kyrgyz approaches and the thousand-li road to Badakhshan.

sentences.zh: 自英吉沙爾東行三百餘里，至葉爾羌城，由城西南轉而東北，設卡倫七處，西南一帶，外通布魯特，東北一帶，專為稽查逃人，乃葉爾羌辦事大臣專轄。

translations.literal: From Yengisar east going three hundred-odd li, to Yarkand city, from the city's southwest turning northeast, seven karun were set up; southwest belt outward connecting Kyrgyz, northeast belt solely for examining and checking fugitives, solely overseen by the Yarkand resident minister.
translations.idiomatic: Three hundred li east to Yarkand, seven karun under the Yarkand minister faced Kyrgyz country to the southwest and fugitive routes to the northeast.

sentences.zh: 又東南行七百餘里，至和闐城，城外之東西河，共設卡倫十二處，為稽查采玉回民，又札馬耳路通阿克蘇，專設卡倫一處，均和闐領隊大臣專轄。

translations.literal: Again southeast going seven hundred-odd li, to Khotan city, outside the city east and west rivers, in all twelve karun were set up, for examining and checking jade-gathering Hui Muslims; again the Zhamar route connecting Aksu, one karun set up solely, all solely overseen by the Khotan commandant-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Seven hundred li farther to Khotan, twelve karun on the eastern and western rivers policed jade diggers, with one more on the Zhamar road to Aksu—all under the Khotan commandant.

sentences.zh: 自葉爾羌東北行一千四百里，至阿克蘇城，其東北路通著勒士斯，專設卡倫一處，稽查喀喇沙爾所屬之土耳扈特游牧，乃阿克蘇辦事大臣專轄。

translations.literal: From Yarkand northeast going one thousand four hundred li, to Aksu city, its northeast route connecting Chale Shisi, one karun set up solely, examining and checking Karashahr-subordinate Torghut nomadism, solely overseen by the Aksu resident minister.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen hundred li northeast to Aksu, where one karun on the road to Chale Shisi watched Torghut herds of Karashahr, under the Aksu minister.

sentences.zh: 又東北行七百餘里，至庫車城，由城西北而南，設卡倫五處，又東北行八百餘里，至喀喇沙爾城，城之東北設卡倫二處，又東北行九百餘里，至吐魯番城，由城西南而東，設卡倫六處，又東北行一千七百餘里，至哈密城，城東北設卡倫四處，均由駐紮各城大臣專轄。

translations.literal: Again northeast seven hundred-odd li to Kuche city, from the city northwest southward five karun; again northeast eight hundred-odd li to Karashahr city, city northeast two karun; again northeast nine hundred-odd li to Turfan city, from city southwest eastward six karun; again northeast one thousand seven hundred-odd li to Hami city, city northeast four karun—all solely overseen by the stationed-at-each-city grand ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Northeastward in turn: seven hundred li to Kuche with five karun; eight hundred to Karashahr with two; nine hundred to Turfan with six; seventeen hundred to Hami with four—each city under its resident minister.

sentences.zh: 此回疆各城所屬大小卡倫之方向也。

translations.literal: This was the orientation of the Muslim frontier each city's subordinate large and small karun.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the layout of karun across the Muslim frontier cities.

sentences.zh: 自咸、同朝回逆鴟張，俄羅斯復乘機蠶食，邊堠盡廢。

translations.literal: From the Xianfeng and Tongzhi reigns when Muslim rebels spread like owls, Russia again seized the opportunity to nibble and devour, border beacon mounds were entirely abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: From the Xianfeng and Tongzhi eras, as Muslim rebels rose and Russia encroached, the frontier beacons fell into ruin.

sentences.zh: 迨新疆定後，至光緒五年，收回伊犁，與俄羅斯畫定邊界，規復舊日卡倫之制。

translations.literal: When Xinjiang was settled afterward, reaching the fifth year of Guangxu, recovering Ili, with Russia drawing and fixing the boundary, planning to restore the old karun system.
translations.idiomatic: After Xinjiang was pacified, the recovery of Ili in Guangxu 5 and a new boundary with Russia revived the old karun network.

sentences.zh: 卡倫之例有三：其在內者曰常設卡倫，在外者曰移設卡倫，最在外者曰添設卡倫。

translations.literal: Karun precedents were three: those within were called permanent-set karun, those outside were called moved-set karun, those outermost were called added-set karun.
translations.idiomatic: Karun fell into three classes: permanent posts on the inner line, seasonal posts pushed outward in summer, and forward posts pushed farthest out.

sentences.zh: 三者惟常設卡倫為永遠駐守之地。

translations.literal: Of the three, only permanent-set karun were forever garrisoned places.
translations.idiomatic: Only the permanent karun were manned year-round.

sentences.zh: 餘皆值氣候和暖則外展，寒則內遷，進退盈縮，或千里，或數百里不等，沙漠浩蕩，漫無定準，皆在常設卡倫之外。

translations.literal: The rest all when climate was mild then extended outward, when cold then shifted inward; advance and retreat expanding and contracting, sometimes a thousand li, sometimes several hundred li unequal; desert vast and boundless, without fixed standard—all outside permanent-set karun.
translations.idiomatic: The others advanced in warm seasons and withdrew in cold, sometimes a thousand li, sometimes hundreds, across trackless desert beyond the permanent line.

sentences.zh: 自西域亂作，凡移設、添設之卡倫，悉為俄人所攘奪。

translations.literal: From when turmoil arose in the Western Regions, every moved-set and added-set karun were all seized and snatched away by Russians.
translations.idiomatic: Once the western regions erupted in rebellion, Russia seized every seasonal and forward karun.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠平定新疆，乃與俄羅斯重定界約，凡常設卡倫以外，均作為甌脫之地，中、俄邊境之民，彼此不居，以免逼處。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang pacified Xinjiang, then with Russia anew fixed boundary treaties; all outside permanent-set karun were made buffer-zone lands; Chinese and Russian border peoples, each side did not dwell, to avoid pressing close together.
translations.idiomatic: After Zuo Zongtang pacified Xinjiang, a new treaty with Russia turned all ground beyond the permanent karun into a neutral buffer where neither side would settle, lest the populations press against each other.

sentences.zh: 其常設卡倫，嚴申舊制，邊烽少息矣。

translations.literal: Its permanent-set karun strictly proclaimed the old system; border beacon fires somewhat ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Permanent karun were manned under the old rules, and frontier alarms grew rare.

sentences.zh: 其黔、楚苗疆碉堡之制，始於嘉慶朝征苗之役，傅鼐精練鄉兵，遍設碉堡，師苗技以制苗，遂平邊患。

translations.literal: The system of Guizhou and Chu Miao frontier blockhouses began in the Jiaqing reign's campaign against the Miao; Fu Nao finely drilled local militia, everywhere set up blockhouses, taking Miao techniques to control Miao, then pacified border troubles.
translations.idiomatic: Blockhouses in the Guizhou and Hunan Miao marches began with the Jiaqing campaigns: Fu Nao trained local militia, built blockhouses on every height, and turned Miao tactics against them until the frontier was quiet.

sentences.zh: 自湖南乾州界之木林坪起，至中營之四路口，築圍牆百數十里，以杜竄擾。

translations.literal: From Hunan Qianzhou border's Mulinping starting, to Zhongying's Silukou, enclosing walls of one hundred-odd ten li were built, to block and stop raids and harassment.
translations.idiomatic: From Mulinping on the Qianzhou border to Silukou at Zhongying, a palisade wall of more than a hundred li blocked infiltration.

sentences.zh: 其險隘處增設屯堡，聯以碉卡。

translations.literal: At its dangerous passes additional fortified hamlets were set up, linked by blockhouse karun.
translations.idiomatic: At choke points they added garrison hamlets linked by blockhouses and karun posts.

sentences.zh: 鳳凰廳境內，設堡卡碉台八百八十七座。

translations.literal: Within Fenghuang subprefecture territory, eight hundred eighty-seven forts, karun, blockhouses, and watch towers were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Fenghuang district held 887 forts, karun posts, blockhouses, and watch towers.

sentences.zh: 永綏廳境內，設堡卡碉台一百三十二座。

translations.literal: Within Yongshui subprefecture territory, one hundred thirty-two forts, karun, blockhouses, and watch towers were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Yongshui district had 132 such strongpoints.

sentences.zh: 乾州廳境內，設汛碉一百二十一處。

translations.literal: Within Qianzhou subprefecture territory, one hundred twenty-one rotation-garrison blockhouses were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Qianzhou maintained 121 garrison blockhouses on rotation.

sentences.zh: 古丈坪及保縣境內，設汛碉六十九處。

translations.literal: Within Guzhangping and Baoxian territory, sixty-nine rotation-garrison blockhouses were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Guzhangping and Baoxian together had 69 rotation blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 環苗疆數百里，烽燧相望，聲息相聞。

translations.literal: Encircling the Miao frontier several hundred li, beacon fires faced one another, sound and breath heard mutually.
translations.idiomatic: For hundreds of li around the Miao country, beacon towers stood within sight and earshot of one another.

sentences.zh: 關牆則沿山澗建之。

translations.literal: Barrier walls then were built along mountain streams and ravines.
translations.idiomatic: Barrier walls followed ridges and ravines.

sentences.zh: 砲台則擇衝要處築之，哨台則於關牆之隙修之。

translations.literal: Gun platforms then were built at chosen strategic points; sentry towers were repaired in gaps of the barrier walls.
translations.idiomatic: Gun batteries rose at critical points; watch towers filled gaps in the barrier wall.

sentences.zh: 卡碉屯堡，則因地制宜，或品字式，或一字式，或梅花式。

translations.literal: Karun blockhouses and fortified hamlets then suited local conditions, either pin-character form, or one-line form, or plum-blossom form.
translations.idiomatic: Karun, blockhouses, and garrison hamlets were laid out as terrain required—in pin-shaped, linear, or plum-blossom formations.

sentences.zh: 其修建之制，關牆則土石兼施，砲台則以石砌，而築土以實中心，哨台亦石砌，環鑿槍孔，高峻堅實。

translations.literal: Their construction system: barrier walls used earth and stone together; gun platforms used stone laid, and piled earth to solidify the center; sentry towers also stone laid, around carved gun holes, high steep solid and firm.
translations.idiomatic: Barrier walls mixed earth and stone; gun platforms were stone-faced with packed earth cores; watch towers were stone-built with loopholes ringing the walls—lofty, steep, and solid.

sentences.zh: 碉樓之制亦然。

translations.literal: The blockhouse-tower system was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Blockhouse towers followed the same rule.

sentences.zh: 關牆以嚴邊界，砲台以備堵截戰守，哨台為巡邏瞭望之用，屯堡為邊民聚衛之所，卡碉則戰守兼資。

translations.literal: Barrier walls to tighten the border; gun platforms to prepare for blocking interception battle and defense; sentry towers for patrol rounds and lookout use; fortified hamlets as places where border people gathered for mutual defense; karun blockhouses then combined battle and defense.
translations.idiomatic: Barrier walls sealed the line; gun batteries blocked and fought; watch towers patrolled and watched; garrison hamlets sheltered border communities; karun blockhouses served both attack and defense.

sentences.zh: 其防守兵丁，有警則荷戈，無事則秉耒，進攻退守，為持久計，以待敵之可勝，遂以底定蠻荒雲。

translations.literal: Their defending soldiers, when there was alarm then shouldered weapons, when no affair then held hoes; advancing to attack and retreating to defend, as a plan for endurance, waiting until the enemy could be defeated—thus to settle the barbarian wilds at last.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison troops took up arms when alarm sounded and returned to the plow in peacetime, advancing to strike and falling back to hold as a long-term strategy until the enemy could be overcome—thus the tribal frontier was brought to lasting order.
